The first artist is Vincent van Gogh. According to research, the French city of Arles, ⓐwhere van Gogh spent his later years, had exceptionally bright and intense sunlight. Van Gogh expressed the sunlight, energy, and the joy of life he
ⓑfeeling there through bright yellow colors. During his short life of 37 years, he created more than 900 paintings, around 300 ⓒof which feature mostly yellow. The series of paintings
ⓓcalling Sunflowers includes some of his most recognizable works. Some have said that his preference for yellow in his artwork was due to a medical condition that forced him to see mainly yellow. While this may be true, we can also see his use of blue, orange, and other colors, and these combinations of colors serve ⓔto emphasize his joy being conveyed. , _____ → , _____ →
solution: ⓑ feeling → felt 관계대명사가 생략된 목적격 관계절 'he there'에서 동사가 필요하다. 문맥상 '그가 그곳에서 느꼈던 삶의 기쁨'이라는 의미이므로, 분사형 feeling이 아니라 과거 시제 동사 felt가 와야 한다. feeling은 이 자리에서 관계절의 정동사 역할을 할 수 없다. ⓓ calling → called 'The series of paintings'를 뒤에서 수식하는 분사구이다. 'Sunflowers'라는 이름으로 불리는 것은 paintings이므로, paintings와 call의 관계는 수동(paintings are called Sunflowers)이다. 따라서 능동의 현재분사 calling이 아니라 수동의 과거분사 called가 와야 한다. ⓐ 'the French city of Arles'를 선행사로 하는 관계절에서 '반 고흐가 만년을 보낸 장소'라는 의미이므로, 장소를 나타내는 관계부사 where가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓒ 'around 300 of which feature mostly yellow'는 「of which + 주어 + 동사」 구조의 관계절로, 선행사 '900 paintings' 중 300점을 가리킨다. 주어가 복수(300)이므로 동사 feature(복수 일치)도 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓔ 'serve to-부정사' 구조는 '~하는 역할을 하다'라는 의미의 관용 표현으로, to emphasize가 올바르게 쓰였다.

[sitting / seating] on the ground, deep in thought. Sometimes red is used to (D) [express / expressing] the beauty of nature. Claude Monet's Autumn Effect at Argenteuil shows how the artist celebrated beautiful autumn moments. The bright reds in the painting (E) [symbolize / symbolizes] the amazing and transformative power of nature. The painting captures the dramatic moment when the forest turns bright red and is reflected on the surface of the river.

ⓑseriously harm satellites that provide services across the world. In addition, each crash has the potential to

Various space ⓓinstitutions and even entrepreneurs are actively working on solutions to reduce the amount of space junk in orbit. These efforts include the development of innovative technologies such as robotic arms to capture and remove large pieces of space junk as well as the improvement of tracking systems to better avoid space junk. What’s more, researchers are also investigating recycling existing space junk to reduce its impact on future space activities. The need to explore new frontiers like the Arctic and the American West may have been ⓐsparked by curiosity, but a major reason was to discover new resources. Without new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and ⓑthe growth of cities. In the late 20th century, the Information Technology Revolution connected the world and
ⓒtransformed economies. Now, it seems that space is the latest frontier for entrepreneurs ⓓto exploring. Finding new resources and exploring the unique environment are new opportunities for those who dare ⓔto take up the challenge.
solution: ④ to exploring → to explore 'for entrepreneurs to explore'에서 'for + 목적어 + to부정사' 구문이 쓰인 자리이다. to부정사는 'to + 동사원형'의 형태를 취해야 하므로, to exploring을 to explore로 고쳐야 한다. ① 'may have been sparked'는 수동태 완료 표현으로, 주어인 'The need'가 호기심에 의해 촉발된 것이므로 과거분사 sparked가 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 전치사 'of'의 목적어로 명사구 'the growth'가 올바르게 쓰였다. 'the rise of ~'와 대등하게 연결되어 있으므로 어법상 적절하다. ③ 문장의 주어 'the Information Technology Revolution'에 대한 서술어로, connected와 병렬 관계를 이루는 동사 transformed가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 'dare to take up'에서 dare는 일반동사로 쓰여 to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 구조이며, to take가 올바르게 쓰였다.

For example, one asteroid, 16 Psyche, is reported to consist mainly of gold and other precious metals, ⓑwhose value is equal to billions of dollars per person on Earth. From a space explorers' perspective, however, the most valuable resources from asteroids are neither valuable precious metals nor rare mineral deposits. That valuable resource could actually be water, and it seems ⓒto have been overlooking because it doesn't seem as exciting as gold. They may work independently or be controlled remotely from Earth. Unfortunately, these types of robots have ⓔyet to be developed since the technology is still young. As technology continues to develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly emerge.
solution: ③ to have been overlooking → to have been overlooked 수식하는 주어인 it(= water)은 '간과되는' 대상이므로 수동의 의미가 필요하다. 따라서 능동형 현재분사 overlooking이 아니라 과거분사 overlooked를 써서 수동태 완료부정사 'to have been overlooked'로 고쳐야 한다. 따라서 ③이 정답이다. ① 'The solar system is composed of many rocks'에서 be composed of는 '~로 구성되다'라는 의미의 수동태 표현으로, composed가 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 선행사 'gold and other precious metals'를 받아 '그것들의 가치'라는 소유의 의미를 나타내는 소유격 관계대명사 whose가 올바르게 쓰였다. ④ 'They will be programmed to explore'에서 로봇이 프로그래밍되는 대상이므로 수동태 be programmed가 쓰였고, 뒤에 to부정사가 이어지는 것도 올바른 구조이다. ⑤ 'have yet to be developed'는 '아직 개발되지 않았다'는 의미로, 'have yet to + 동사원형' 구조가 올바르게 쓰였다.

solution: ⓑ which → whose 선행사 'precious metals'의 소유 관계를 나타내는 관계대명사가 필요하다. 뒤에 명사 'value'가 바로 이어지므로 소유격 관계대명사 whose를 써야 한다. which는 주격 또는 목적격 관계대명사이므로 뒤에 명사를 직접 수식할 수 없어 어법상 틀렸다. ⓒ to have → to have been 주어인 'it(water)'은 '간과되는' 대상이므로 수동의 의미가 필요하다. 따라서 능동형 완료부정사 to have overlooked가 아니라 수동형 완료부정사 to have been overlooked로 써야 한다. to have만 쓰면 'water가 무언가를 간과했다'는 능동의 의미가 되어 문맥상 어색하다. ⓐ 'The large ones are called planets'에서 수동의 의미로 과거분사 called가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓓ 'Robots will be sent to dig ~'에서 주어 Robots가 보내지는 대상이므로 수동태 be sent가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓔ 'continues to develop'에서 continue는 to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 동사이므로 to develop이 올바르게 쓰였다.

(B)[latest / last] frontier for entrepreneurs to explore. Finding new resources and exploring the unique environment are new opportunities for those (C)[which / who] dare to take up the challenge.

글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어가기에 어법상 알맞은 것은?
solution: (A) would 「Without + 명사」는 가정의 의미를 나타내며, 이 문장은 과거 사실에 반대되는 내용을 가정하는 가정법 과거완료 구문이다. 따라서 결과절에는 「would have p.p. 」 형태가 와야 자연스럽다. would not have led to : ~로 이어지지 않았을 것이다 반면 should not have led to는 “~로 이어지지 말았어야 했다”라는 당위·의무의 의미가 되어 문맥에 맞지 않는다. (B) latest latest는 late의 최상급으로 “가장 최근의, 최신의”라는 뜻이다. 본문에서는 우주가 현재 가장 최근에 주목받는 새로운 frontier(개척지)라는 의미이므로 latest가 적절하다. 반면 last는 “맨 마지막의”라는 뜻으로, 순서상 끝을 나타낼 때 사용하므로 문맥에 맞지 않는다. (C) who 선행사 those는 사람을 가리키므로 관계대명사 who를 사용해야 한다. those who dare to take up the challenge : 그 도전을 감행할 용기가 있는 사람들 which는 사물이나 동물을 선행사로 받을 때 사용하므로 적절하지 않다.

다음 글의 흐름상 밑줄 친 우리말과 같은 의미가 되도록 <
조건>에 맞추어 문장을 완성하시오.
Although the sun's radiation can be unhealthy for our skin, getting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere could also benefit the testing of products. For example, fabrics and skin creams could be tested for their ability to protect against solar radiation. Also, semiconductors and glass communication cables could be produced with higher purity and fewer faults. Space technology has advanced greatly, and it seems that the cost of running a space program and improving it has decreased substantially since ambitious entrepreneurs have joined the adventure. The conditions in space open up the possibility of manufacturing newer and better products. Challenges remain, but it's not unreasonable to imagine sending a message from a device equipped with semiconductors that were produced in space. The space project will ultimately reach a point where adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system. The resources required to drive economic activity that have existed far beyond the reach of humanity are becoming much more reachable. 문 제는 더 이상 '어떻게'에 관한 것이 아니라, '언제'에 관한 것이다.
조건 1. 주어진 <보기>의 단어들을 모두 한 번씩만 사 용하여 바르게 배열할 것. (단어 추가 및 변형불가)
2. 세미콜론(;)을 사용하여 두 개의 절을 자연스럽 게 연결할 것.
3. 대문자 시작 및 마침표 등 구두점에 유의하여 작성할 것.
보기 no / about / the / how / when / longer / is / it / about / question / is
→ _____
answer: The question is no longer about how; it is about when.
solution: 문제는 더 이상 ~이 아니다'는 부정어구 'no longer'를 동사 뒤에 배치하여 'The question is no longer ~'로 표현하는 것이 알맞다. '~에 관한'은 전치사 'about'을 사용하며, 전치사의 목적어 자리에 명사절 역할을 하는 의문사 'how'와 'when'을 각각 배치하는 것이 알맞다. 앞 절의 부정적인 내용('어떻게'가 아님)을 부연하여 긍정적인 내용('언제'임)으로 대조 및 연결하기 위해, 세미콜론(;)을 사용하여 'The question is no longer about how'와 대명사 it으로 주어를 받은 'it is about when'을 이어주는 것이 알맞다.

body:
다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
Since the beginning of the space age in the 1950s, thousands of rockets and satellites have been launched into space. Most have functioned as they were designed to, but over time, some machines have broken down and remain floating around in space because they are difficult to bring back. Dead satellites, used rocket parts, and small pieces of dirt are in orbit. Those objects left unattended in space are collectively referred to as space junk. The presence of space junk significantly increases risks to space activities and the safety of astronauts. For example, small pieces of junk might not seem like a big issue, but they move at 6.7 kilometers per second. At that speed, even a small piece of metal can seriously harm satellites that provide services across the world. In addition, each crash has the potential to generate more space junk. Without active efforts to remove the junk, traveling in space would be extremely dangerous.
choices: Space junk poses serious risks to space activities, so active efforts to remove it are necessary.
Rockets and satellites launched since the 1950s have mostly failed to function as intended.
Small pieces of space debris travel too slowly to cause any real damage to satellites.
International cooperation has already solved most of the problems caused by space junk.
The safety of astronauts is no longer affected by objects left in orbit around Earth. 1회차 실전 모의고사 유형보충독해1
solution: ① 이 글은 우주 쓰레기가 우주 활동과 우주비행사의 안전에 심각한 위험을 초래한다는 점을 구체적 근거(속도, 충돌 시 추가 파편 발생)로 설명한 뒤, 마지막 문장에서 이를 제거하려는 적극적인 노력이 없다면 우주여행이 매우 위험해질 것이라고 강조하므로 요지로 가장 알맞다. ② 대부분의 로켓과 위성이 의도대로 작동하지 '못했다'는 내용은 본문과 반대되므로(Most have functioned as they were designed to) 알맞지 않다. ③ 작은 파편이 초당 6.7km라는 매우 빠른 속도로 이동하며 위성에 심각한 피해를 줄 수 있다고 했으므로, 속도가 느려 피해가 없다는 내용은 본문과 반대되어 알맞지 않다. ④ 국제 협력으로 문제가 대부분 해결되었다는 내용은 본문에 없으며, 오히려 적극적인 노력이 '없다면(Without)' 위험하다는 경고로 마무리되므로 알맞지 않다. ⑤ 우주비행사의 안전이 더 이상 영향받지 않는다는 내용은 본문과 정반대이므로 알맞지 않다.

answer: ⓐ to be tested ⓑ produced ⓒ getting away from
solution: ⓐ candidates를 수식하는 to부정사 자리이며, 우주에서 '시험되는' 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 나타내야 한다. 따라서 < 보기>의 test에 to be를 추가하여 수동태 to부정사 to be tested(3단어)로 쓴다. ⓑⓐ의 to be를 공유하며 등위접속사 and로 병렬을 이루는 자리이므로, <보기>의 produce를 과거분사형으로 바꾸어 produced(1단어)로 쓴다. ⓒ 문장의 주어 역할을 하는 동명사 자리이며, 뒤에 오는 명사구(the protective effects of the atmosphere)와 연결되어 '~에서 벗어나다'라는 의미를 나타내기 위해' 전치사 from이 필요하다. 따라서 <보기>의 get away에 전치사 from을 추가하고 동명사로 바꾸어 getting away from(3단어)으로 쓴다.

body:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
Being on the International Space Station (ISS) is a unique experience. Astronauts live and work in microgravity, floating around instead of walking. Researchers get to see Earth from a completely new perspective, and they get to work on important scientific research in conditions that are different from Earth's. Many manufacturers are interested in manufacturing in space because the quality of a lot of products manufactured on Earth is influenced by temperature, pressure, radiation, and even the effects of gravity. Creating good conditions for certain types of manufacturing on Earth requires the use of a lot of energy and resources, but those conditions occur naturally in space. Drugs, beauty and food products, and advanced materials are all potential candidates to be tested and produced in space. For example, without the effects of gravity, products that require a uniform quality like cosmetics would be easier to mix. Other materials like 3D printed skin or muscle benefit from low pressure and gravity too. Although the sun's radiation can be unhealthy for our skin, getting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere could also benefit the testing of products. For example, fabrics and skin creams could be tested for their ability to protect against solar radiation. Also, semiconductors and glass communication cables could be produced with higher purity and fewer faults.
choices: 우주 비행사들은 걷지 않고 떠다니며, 극미 중력 속에서 살고 일한다.
지구에서 제조되는 많은 제품의 품질은 온도, 압력, 방사선 및 중력에 의해서 영향을 받는다.
여러 제품 중 의약품, 미용 및 식품 제품과 첨단 재료는 모두 우주에 서 실험되었던 후보들이다.
3D 프린터로 인쇄된 피부나 근육과 같은 재료들은 낮은 압력과 중력 의 혜택을 받는다.
비록 태양의 방사선이 피부에 좋지 않지만, 대기의 보호 효과에서 벗 어나는 것은 제품을 실험하는 데에 도움이 될 수 있다.
solution: 의약품, 미용 및 식품 제품, 첨단 재료는 우주에서 테스트되고 생산될 잠재적 후보라고 했으므로, 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은 ③이다.

ⓓthose found on the surface will later be prepared for transport. If necessary, ⓔthese may work independently or be controlled remotely from Earth. As technology continues to develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly emerge.

solution: ⓐ 로봇들을 가리킨다. ⓑ 로봇들을 가리킨다. ⓒ 대상 물질들을 가리킨다.. ⓓ 대상 물질들을 가리킨다. ⓔ 로봇들을 가리킨다. 같은 대상끼리 묶인 것은 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓔ와 ⓒ, ⓓ이므로, 정답은 ②이다.

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
Being on the International Space Station (ISS) is a unique experience. Astronauts live and work in microgravity, floating around instead of walking. Researchers get to see Earth from a completely new perspective, and they get to work on important scientific research in conditions that are different from Earth’s. Many manufacturers are interested in manufacturing in space because the quality of a lot of products manufactured on Earth is influenced by temperature, pressure, radiation, and even the effects of gravity. Creating good conditions for certain types of manufacturing on Earth requires the use of a lot of energy and resources, but those conditions occur naturally in space. ⓐ Drugs, beauty and food products, and advanced materials are all potential candidates to be tested and produced in space. ⓑ For example, (A) without the effects of gravity, products that require a uniform quality like cosmetics would be easier to mix. ⓒ However, producing high-quality cosmetics on Earth is still much cheaper and less time-consuming than in space. ⓓ Other materials like 3D printed skin or muscle benefit from low pressure and gravity too. ⓔ Although the sun’s radiation can be unhealthy for our skin, getting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere could also benefit the testing of products. For example, fabrics and skin creams could be tested for their ability to protect against solar radiation. Also, semiconductors and glass communication cables could be produced with higher purity and fewer faults.

밑줄 친 (A)와 같은 용법으로 사용된 것을 <보기>에서 모두 골라 기호를 쓰고, 그 문장들을 해석하시오.
보기 ⓐHe walked into the classroom without making any noise.
ⓑI would have made a terrible mistake without your timely advice.
ⓒShe managed to finish the difficult project without any help.
ⓓNo living things could survive on Earth without the sun.
ⓔYou cannot enter the building without showing your identification card.
→
answer: ⓑ 당신의 시기적절한 조언이 없었더라면, 나는 끔찍한 실수 를 저질렀을 것이다. ⓓ 태양이 없다면, 지구상의 어떤 생명체도 생존할 수 없을 것 이다.
solution: (A)는 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정을 나타내는 가정법 과거 용법이다. <보기> 중 이와 같은 용법으로 쓰인 것은 다음과 같다. ⓑ 과거 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거완료 문장이다. ⓓ 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거 문장이다.

solution: ② 'the quality of a lot of products manufactured on Earth'가 주어이고, 'is influenced by'는 수동태로 올바르게 쓰였다. 온도, 압력, 방사선, 중력의 영향에 의해 제품의 질이 '영향을 받는' 것이므로 수동태가 적절하며, 어법상 옳다. 따라서 ②가 정답이다. ① floated → floating 'Astronauts live and work in microgravity'에 이어지는 분사구문으로, 주어인 Astronauts가 능동적으로 '떠다니는' 행위를 하고 있으므로 현재분사 floating이 와야 한다. 과거분사 floated는 수동의 의미를 나타내므로 문맥상 부적절하다. ③ natural → naturally 동사 'occur'를 수식하는 부사가 필요한 자리이다. 형용사 natural은 동사를 수식할 수 없으므로, 부사형인 naturally로 고쳐야 한다. ④ test → tested 'could be tested'는 수동태 구문으로, 'fabrics and skin creams'가 테스트를 '받는' 대상이므로 과거분사 tested가 와야 한다. 동사원형 test를 쓰면 'could be test'가 되어 수동태 구조가 파괴되므로 틀렸다. ⑤ that has → that have 관계대명사 that의 선행사는 복수 명사 'The resources'이므로, 관계사절의 동사도 복수형인 have를 써야 한다. 단수형 has는 수 일치 오류이다.

The need to explore new frontiers like the Arctic and the American West may have been sparked by curiosity, but a major reason was to discover new resources. Without new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities. In the late 20th century, the Information Technology Revolution connected the world and transformed economies. Now, it seems that space is the latest frontier for entrepreneurs to explore. Finding new resources and exploring the unique environment are new opportunities for those who dare to take up the challenge. 3회차 실전 모의고사
① But for new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities.
② If it had not been for new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities.
③ Had it not been for new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities.
④ If new resources and technology were not, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities.
⑤ Had not it been new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities.
solution: ④ If new resources and technology were not는 가정법 과거(were)의 형태이므로, 주절의 과거완료(would not have led)와 시제가 어긋난다. 과거 사실의 반대를 가정하려면 If new resources and technology had not existed(been available) 등 가정법 과거완료로 써야 하므로 바꿔 쓸 수 없다. ⑤ Had it not been for 의 형태로 쓰여야 한다. ① But for는 '~이 없었다면'이라는 뜻의 가정법 관용 표현으로, Without과 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. ② If it had not been for는 '~이 없었다면'이라는 뜻의 가정법 과거완료 관용 표현으로, Without과 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. ③ Had it not been for는 ②의 if가 생략되고 도치된 형태로, Without과 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. 따라서, 정답은 ④, ⑤가 가장 알맞다.

Off-Earth Manufacturing Being on the International Space Station (ISS) is a unique experience. Astronauts live and work in microgravity, ⓐfloating around instead of walking. Researchers get to see Earth from a completely new perspective, and they get to work on important scientific research in conditions that are different from Earth's. Many manufacturers are interested in manufacturing in space because the quality of a lot of products
ⓑmanufactured on Earth is influenced by temperature, pressure, radiation, and even the effects of gravity. Creating good conditions for certain types of manufacturing on Earth requires the use of a lot of energy and resources, but those conditions occur naturally in space. Drugs, beauty and food products, and advanced materials are all potential candidates to be tested and produced in space. For example, without the effects of gravity, products that require a uniform quality like cosmetics would be easier ⓒto mixing. Other materials like 3D printed skin or muscle benefit from low pressure and gravity too. Although the sun's radiation can be unhealthy for our skin, getting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere could also benefit the testing of products. For example, fabrics and skin creams could be tested for their ability to protect against solar radiation. Also, semiconductors and glass communication cables could be produced with higher purity and fewer faults. Space technology has advanced greatly, and it seems that the cost of running a space program and improving it has decreased substantially since ambitious entrepreneurs have joined the adventure. The conditions in space open up the possibility of manufacturing newer and better products. Challenges remain, but it's not unreasonable to imagine sending a message from a device ⓓequipping with semiconductors that were produced in space. The space project will ultimately reach a point ⓔwhich adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system. The resources required to drive economic activity that have existed far beyond the reach of humanity are becoming much more reachable. The question is no longer about how; it's about when. _____ , _____ → _____ , _____ → _____ , _____ →
answer: ⓒ to mixing → to mix, ⓓ equipping with → equipped with, ⓔ which → where
solution: ⓒ to mixing → to mix "be easier to mix"는 「형용사 + to-부정사」 구문으로, to 뒤에는 반드시 동사원형이 와야 한다. to mixing은 to 뒤에 동명사(-ing)가 온 잘못된 형태이므로 to mix로 고쳐야 한다. ⓓ equipping with → equipped with 선행사 "a device"는 반도체를 장착하는 주체가 아니라 반도체가 장착되는 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 equipped with로 수식해야 한다. 현재분사 equipping with는 능동의 의미를 나타내므로 문맥에 맞지 않는다. ⓔ which → where 선행사 "a point"는 장소(지점)를 나타내는 명사이며, 뒤에 이어지는 절 "adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system"은 완전한 절이다. 완전한 절을 이끌며 장소 선행사를 수식할 때는 관계부사 where를 써야 한다. 관계대명사 which를 쓰면 절 내에 빠진 성분이 있어야 하는데 이 절은 문법적으로 완전하므로 which는 틀렸다. ⓐ floating: "Astronauts live and work in microgravity, floating around instead of walking"에서 floating은 분사구문으로, 주어인 Astronauts가 직접 떠다니는 행위를 하는 것이므로 능동의 현재분사 floating이 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓑ manufactured: "products manufactured on Earth"에서 products는 제조되는 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 manufactured가 올바르게 쓰였다.

body:
밑줄 친 우리말 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
Asteroid Mining The solar system is composed of many rocks floating in space. The large ones are called planets, and the smaller ones are called asteroids. Research has shown that asteroids contain valuable resources like gold and rare earth elements. For example, one asteroid, 16 Psyche, is reported to consist mainly of gold and other precious metals, whose value is equal to billions of dollars per person on Earth. From a space explorers' perspective, however, the most valuable resources from asteroids are neither valuable precious metals nor rare mineral deposits. That valuable resource could actually be water, and it seems to have been overlooked because it doesn't seem as exciting as gold. Water is expensive to transport into space due to its weight and volume. 지구 주위 궤도에 충분한 물 공급원을 가진 우주 정거장을 보유하는 것은 우주 탐사들을 훨씬 더 쉽게 만들 것이다.
No one knows for sure what asteroid mining will look like, but it seems that robotic mining is most likely. Robots will be sent to dig for target materials and send them back towards Earth. They will be programmed to explore the surface and identify materials, and be equipped for tasks such as drilling, collecting, and transporting. They may work independently or be controlled remotely from Earth. Unfortunately, these types of robots have yet to be developed since the technology is still young. As technology continues to develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly emerge.
조건 1. 동명사와 비교급을 모두 사용할 것
2. (space station, sufficient, water supply, orbit, space explorations, easy, make)을 모두 포함할 것
3. 필요 시 어형을 변형할 것
4. 주어진 단어를 모두 활용할 것
→ _____
answer: Having a space station with sufficient water supplies in orbit around Earth would make space explorations much easier.
solution: 문장의 주어 역할을 하도록 동사 have를 동명사 Having으로 변형하여 문두에 위치시킨다. 주어부는 '지구 주위 궤도에 충분한 물 공급원을 가진 우주 정거장을 보유하는 것'의 의미를 가진 Having a space station with sufficient water supplies in orbit around Earth가 된다. (water supply는 지문 원문에 맞춰 복수형 water supplies로 변형) 주어부 뒤에 가정의 의미를 나타내는 조동사 would와 동사 make를 쓰고, [목적어(space explorations) + 목적격 보어 (easier)] 구조를 완성한다. 조건에 맞게 easy를 비교급인 easier로 변형하고, 비교급을 강조하는 부사 much를 앞에 붙여 would make space explorations much easier로 작성한다.

They will be programmed to explore the surface and identify materials, and be equipped for tasks such as drilling, collecting, and transporting. They may work independently or be controlled remotely from Earth. (C)
_____ , these types of robots have yet to be developed since the technology is still young. As technology continues to develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly emerge.

Most have functioned as they were designed to, but over time, some machines have broken down and remain floating around in space because they are difficult to bring back. Dead satellites, used rocket parts, and small pieces of dirt are in orbit. Those objects left unattended in space are collectively referred to as space junk.
ⓐThe absence of space junk significantly increases risks to space activities and the safety of astronauts. For example, small pieces of junk might not seem like a big issue, but they move at 6.7 kilometers per second. At that speed, even a small piece of metal can seriously ⓑharm satellites that provide services across the world. In addition, each crash has the potential to
ⓒeliminate more space junk. Without ⓓactive efforts to remove the junk, ⓔtraveling in space would be extremely dangerous.
solution: ⓐ absence → presence 우주 쓰레기가 '존재함'이 위험을 증가시킨다는 문맥이므로, absence(부재)가 아니라 presence(존재)가 되어야 한다. ⓒ eliminate → generate 충돌이 일어날 때마다 더 많은 우주 쓰레기를 '발생시킬' 수 있다는 문맥이므로, eliminate(제거하다)가 아니라 generate(발생시키다)가 되어야 한다. 따라서, 정답은 ②가 가장 알맞다. ⓑ 작은 금속 조각이 위성에 심각한 '해를 끼칠' 수 있다는 문맥이므로 harm의 쓰임은 적절하다. ⓓ 쓰레기를 제거하기 위한 '적극적인' 노력이라는 의미이므로 active의 쓰임은 적절하다. ⓔ 그러한 노력이 없다면 우주에서의 '여행'이 매우 위험할 것이라는 의미이므로 traveling의 쓰임은 적절하다.

밑줄 친 단어의 영영 풀이로 틀린 것은?
Cleaning Up the Skies Since the beginning of the space age in the 1950s, thousands of rockets and satellites have been launched into space. Most have functioned as they were designed to, but over time, some machines have broken down and remain floating around in space because they are difficult to bring back. Dead satellites, used rocket parts, and small pieces of dirt are in orbit. Those objects left unattended in space are collectively referred to as space junk. The presence of space junk significantly increases risks to space activities and the safety of astronauts. For example, small pieces of junk might not seem like a big issue, but they move at 6.7 kilometers per second. At that speed, even a small piece of metal can seriously harm satellites that provide services across the world. In addition, each crash has the potential to generate more space junk. Without active efforts to remove the junk, traveling in space would be extremely dangerous. 3회차 실전 모의고사 To ensure the safe operation of space activities, it is critical to address the space junk problem.
Various space institutions and even entrepreneurs are actively working on solutions to reduce the amount of space junk in orbit. These efforts include the development of innovative technologies such as robotic arms to capture and remove large pieces of space junk as well as the improvement of tracking systems to better avoid space junk. What’s more, researchers are also investigating recycling existing space junk to reduce its impact on future space activities. This approach not only helps in reducing the space junk problem but also promotes sustainability in space exploration. The long journey toward finding a solution to the space junk problem has only just begun.
choices: satellite : an object sent into space to travel around a planet and collect or send information
unattended : carefully watched or managed by people
potential : a possibility that something may happen or develop in the future
generate : to produce or create something
sustainability : the ability to continue over a long period without harming the environment or using up resources 유형보충독해1
solution: ① satellite : an object sent into space to travel around a planet and collect or send information → satellite는 “인공위성”을 의미한다. 본문에서는 우주 공간에서 다양한 서비스를 제공하는 위성을 설명하는 데 사용되었으므로 올바른 풀이이다. ② unattended : carefully watched or managed by people → unattended는 “방치된, 관리되지 않는”이라는 의미이다. 본문에서 “Those objects left unattended in space” 는 우주 공간에 관리되지 않은 채 남겨진 물체들을 뜻한다. 따라서 “주의 깊게 관리되는”이라는 설명은 반대 의미이므로 틀린 풀이이다. ③ potential : a possibility that something may happen or develop in the future → potential은 “가능성, 잠재력”이라는 뜻이다. 본문에서는 충돌이 더 많은 우주 쓰레기를 만들어 낼 가능성을 의미하므로 올바른 풀이이다. ④ generate : to produce or create something → generate는 “생성하다, 만들어 내다”라는 의미이다. 본문에서 충돌이 더 많은 우주 쓰레기를 만들어 낼 수 있다는 의미로 사용되었으므로 적절한 풀이이다. ⑤ sustainability : the ability to continue over a long period without harming the environment or using up resources → sustainability는 “지속 가능성”이라는 뜻이다. 본문에서는 우주 탐사의 지속 가능성을 높이는 방향으로 재활용 연구가 이루어지고 있다고 설명하므로 올바른 풀이이다. 비상(홍) 4과

body:
다음 글을 읽고 추론할 수 있는 것은?
Since the beginning of the space age in the 1950s, thousands of rockets and satellites have been launched into space. Most have functioned as they were designed to, but over time, some machines have broken down and remain floating around in space because they are difficult to bring back. Dead satellites, used rocket parts, and small pieces of dirt are in orbit. Those objects left unattended in space are collectively referred to as space junk. The presence of space junk significantly increases risks to space activities and the safety of astronauts. For example, small pieces of junk might not seem like a big issue, but they move at 6.7 kilometers per second. At that speed, even a small piece of metal can seriously harm satellites that provide services across the world. In addition, each crash has the potential to generate more space junk. Without active efforts to remove the junk, traveling in space would be extremely dangerous.
choices: 우주 쓰레기 문제는 앞으로 저절로 개선될 가능성이 높다.
크기가 작은 물체라도 빠른 속도로 인해 큰 피해를 줄 수 있 다.
우주비행사들은 우주 쓰레기로부터 어떠한 위협도 받지 않 는다.
1950년대 이전에는 우주로 발사된 로켓이나 위성이 전혀 없었다.
전 세계에 서비스를 제공하는 위성은 우주 쓰레기의 영향을 받지 않는다. 유형보충독해1
solution: ② 작은 금속 조각이라도 초당 6.7킬로미터라는 빠른 속도로 이동해 위성에 심각한 피해를 줄 수 있다는 내용으로 보아, 크기가 작더라도 속도로 인해 큰 피해를 줄 수 있다고 추론할 수 있다. ① 적극적인 제거 노력이 없다면 오히려 더 위험해질 것이라고 했으므로, 저절로 개선될 것이라는 내용은 추론과 반대된다. ③ 우주 쓰레기가 우주비행사의 안전에 위험을 증가시킨다고 명시되어 있으므로, 어떠한 위협도 받지 않는다는 내용은 추론할 수 없다. ④ 1950년대에 우주 시대가 '시작되었다'는 것은 그 이전에는 우주 발사가 없었음을 시사하지만, 이는 이미 본문에 사실상 명시된 내용에 가까우며, 굳이 추론이라기보다 직접적 진술에 더 가까우므로 이 선택지 자체는 추론 문제의 오답으로 적절하지 않게 다뤄질 수 있다. 다만 본문은 로켓과 위성이 '전혀 없었다'는 절대적 부재를 직접 언급하지 않으므로, 과도하게 확대 해석한 추론으로 보아 알맞지 않다. ⑤ 전 세계 서비스를 제공하는 위성이 우주 쓰레기로 인해 '심각한 피해를 입을 수 있다'고 명시되어 있으므로, 영향을 받지 않는다는 내용은 추론과 반대된다.

② In order to ensure the safe operation of space activities
③ So that space activities can be safely operated
④ In order it will ensure the safe operation of space activities

solution: ② 'In order to부정사'는 '~하기 위해서'라는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사 관용 표현으로, 의미와 구조가 그대로 대응되어 바꾸어 쓸 수 있다. ③ 목적을 나타내는 접속사 So that 뒤에 조동사 can을 포함한 완전한 절이 이어지는 표준적인 목적 부사절 구조로, 원문과 의미가 자연스럽게 대응되어 바꾸어 쓸 수 있다. ① 목적을 나타내는 관용 표현은 so as to이며, so to라는 표현은 어법상 옳지 않다. ④ 'In order that 주어 + 동사 ~'는 '~하기 위해서'라는 to부정사구의 문장 전환으로 In order 뒤에는 절을 이끄는 접속사 that이 반드시 와야 하는데, that이 빠진 채 곧바로 절이 이어져 있으므로 바꾸어 쓸 수 없다. ⑤ So that 뒤에는 주어와 동사를 갖춘 완전한 절이 와야 하는데, 동사 자리에 동명사 ensuring이 쓰여 절 구조가 성립하지 않으므로 바꾸어 쓸 수 없다.

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
Being on the International Space Station (ISS) is a unique experience. Astronauts live and work in microgravity, floating around instead of walking. Researchers get to see Earth from a completely new perspective, and they get to work on important scientific research in conditions that are different from Earth's. Many manufacturers are interested in manufacturing in space because the quality of a lot of products manufactured on Earth is influenced by temperature, pressure, radiation, and even the effects of gravity. Creating good conditions for certain types of manufacturing on Earth requires the use of a lot of energy and resources, but those conditions occur naturally in space. Drugs, beauty and food products, and advanced materials are all potential candidates to be tested and produced in space. For example, without the effects of gravity, products that require a uniform quality like cosmetics would be easier to mix. Other materials like 3D printed skin or muscle benefit from low pressure and gravity too. Although the sun's radiation can be unhealthy for our skin, getting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere could also benefit the testing of products. For example, fabrics and skin creams could be tested for their ability to protect against solar radiation. Also, semiconductors and glass communication cables could be produced with higher purity and fewer faults.

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: 우주비행사들은 국제우주정거장(ISS)에서 미세중력 속에서 떠다니며 생활하고 일한다.
지구에서 특정한 제조 조건을 만들기 위해서는 많은 에너지 와 자원이 필요하지만, 그런 조건은 우주에서 자연적으로 형 성된다.
화장품처럼 균일한 품질이 필요한 제품은 중력이 없는 환경 에서 더 쉽게 혼합될 수 있다.
태양 복사열은 피부에 해로울 뿐만 아니라, 대기의 보호가 없 는 우주 환경에서는 피부 크림과 같은 제품을 시험하는 데에 도 오히려 방해가 된다.
반도체와 유리 통신 케이블은 우주에서 더 높은 순도와 더 적 은 결함으로 생산될 수 있다.
solution: 태양 복사열이 피부에 해로울 수 있지만, 대기의 보호 효과가 없는 환경은 제품의 능력을 시험하는 데 도움이 된다고 했으므로, 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은 ④이다.

The need to explore new frontiers like the Arctic and the American West may have been sparked by curiosity, but a major reason was to discover new resources. Without new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities. Finding new resources and exploring the unique environment are new opportunities for those who dare to take up the challenge.

a biography of entrepreneurs who succeeded in the 19th century Industrial Revolution

Space: The Final Frontier The need to explore new frontiers like the Arctic and the American West may have been sparked by curiosity, but a major reason was to discover new resources. Without new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities. In the late 20th century, the Information Technology Revolution connected the world and transformed economies. Now, it seems that space is the latest frontier for entrepreneurs to explore. Finding new resources and exploring the unique environment are new opportunities for those who dare to take up the challenge.
choices: frontier : a feeling of fear or worry about something dangerous or difficult
resource : something useful that can be used to help achieve something
transform : to change something completely into a different form or state
dare : to be brave enough to do something difficult or risky
take up : to begin doing or dealing with something 4회차 실전 모의고사
solution: ① frontier : a feeling of fear or worry about something dangerous or difficult → 글에서 frontier는 “새로운 개척지, 미개척 분야”라는 의미로 사용되었다. 따라서 위의 풀이는 감정(두려움, 걱정)을 설명하고 있으므로 알맞지 않다. ② resource : something useful that can be used to help achieve something → 본문에서 resources는 산업 발전과 경제 성장에 필요한 “자원”의 의미로 쓰였으므로 적절한 풀이이다. ③ transform : to change something completely into a different form or state → Information Technology Revolution이 세계와 경제를 “변화시켰다”는 내용이므로 올바른 풀이이다. ④ dare : to be brave enough to do something difficult or risky → 우주 탐사라는 도전적인 일을 감행할 용기를 의미하므로 적절하다. ⑤ take up : to begin doing or dealing with something → 새로운 도전에 “나서다, 시작하다”의 의미로 사용되었으므로 알맞은 풀이이다.

body:
밑줄 친 우리말과 일치하도록 아래의 단어들을 바르게 배 열하시오.
Being on the International Space Station (ISS) is a unique experience. 우주비행사들은 걸어 다니는 대신 둥둥 _____ 떠다니며 미세중력 속에서 살고 일한다.
Researchers get to see Earth from a completely new perspective, and they get to work on important scientific research in conditions that are different from Earth's. Many manufacturers are interested in manufacturing in space because the quality of a lot of products manufactured on Earth is influenced by temperature, pressure, radiation, and even the effects of gravity. Creating good conditions for certain types of manufacturing on Earth requires the use of a lot of energy and resources, but those conditions occur naturally in space. Drugs, beauty and food products, and advanced materials are all potential candidates to be tested and produced in space. For example, without the effects of gravity, products that require a uniform quality like cosmetics would be easier to mix. Other materials like 3D printed skin or muscle benefit from low pressure and gravity too. Although the sun's radiation can be unhealthy for our skin, getting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere could also benefit the testing of products. For example, fabrics and skin creams could be tested for their ability to protect against solar radiation. Also, semiconductors and glass communication cables could be produced with higher purity and fewer faults. Space technology has advanced greatly, and it seems that the cost of running a space program and improving it has decreased substantially since ambitious entrepreneurs have joined the adventure. The conditions in space open up the possibility of manufacturing newer and better products. Challenges remain, but it's not unreasonable to imagine sending a message from a device equipped with semiconductors that were produced in space. The space project will ultimately reach a point where adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system. The resources required to drive economic activity that have existed far beyond the reach of humanity are becoming much more reachable. The question is no longer about how; it's about when.
보기 floating / in / around / instead / Astronauts / of / work / microgravity / and / live / walking
→ _____ 4회차 실전 모의고사
answer: Astronauts live and work in microgravity, floating around instead of walking.
solution: 분사구문 'floating around'은 동시 동작을 나타내며 주절 뒤에 위치한다. 'instead of walking'은 '걸어 다니는 대신'이라는 의미로 전치사 'instead of' 뒤에 동명사 'walking'을 쓴다. 따라서 주어 'Astronauts'로 시작하여 'live and work in microgravity'를 쓰고, 분사구문 'floating around instead of walking'을 뒤에 붙여 완성한다.

body:
밑줄 친 단어의 영영 풀이로 맞는 것은?
Space technology has advanced greatly, and it seems that the cost of running a space program and improving it has decreased substantially since ambitious entrepreneurs have joined the adventure. The conditions in space open up the possibility of manufacturing newer and better products. Challenges remain, but it’s not unreasonable to imagine sending a message from a device equipped with semiconductors that were produced in space. The space project will ultimately reach a point where adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system. The resources required to drive economic activity that have existed far beyond the reach of humanity are becoming much more reachable. The question is no longer about how; it’s about when.
choices: substantially : in a way that happens only for a short period of time
unreasonable : not fair, sensible, or acceptable
semiconductor : a machine used for sending people into space
adventurous : feeling tired and unwilling to try new things
drive : to stop or slow down the progress of something
solution: ① substantially : in a way that happens only for a short period of time → substantially는 “상당히, 크게”라는 의미이다. 본문에서는 우주 프로그램 운영 비용이 크게 감소했다는 의미로 사용되었으므로, “짧은 기간 동안”이라는 설명은 적절하지 않다. ② unreasonable : not fair, sensible, or acceptable → unreasonable은 “비합리적인, 이치에 맞지 않는”이라는 뜻이다. 본문에서 “it’s not unreasonable to imagine …” 은 “상상하는 것이 비합리적이지 않다”라는 의미이므로 올바른 풀이이다. ③ semiconductor : a machine used for sending people into space → semiconductor는 “반도체”를 의미한다. 우주로 사람을 보내는 기계를 뜻하지 않으므로 틀린 풀이이다. ④ adventurous : feeling tired and unwilling to try new things → adventurous는 “모험심이 있는”이라는 뜻이다. 새로운 것을 시도하기 싫어하는 상태를 의미하지 않는다. ⑤ drive : to stop or slow down the progress of something → 본문에서 drive economic activity는 “경제 활동을 추진하다, 움직이게 하다”라는 의미이다. 따라서 “진행을 멈추거나 늦추다”라는 설명은 적절하지 않다.

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
The solar system is composed of many rocks floating in space. The large ones are called planets, and the smaller ones are called asteroids. Research has shown that asteroids contain valuable resources like gold and rare earth elements. (A) One asteroid, 16 Psyche, is reported to consist mainly of gold and other precious metals,
ⓐwhose value is equal to billions of dollars per person on Earth. (B) That valuable resource could actually be water, and it seems to have been overlooked because it doesn’t seem as ⓑexcited as gold. (C) Water is expensive to transport into space due to its weight and volume. (D) (가) Having a space station with sufficient water supplies in orbit around Earth would make space explorations
ⓒmuch easier. (E) No one knows for sure what asteroid mining will look like, but it seems that robotic mining is most likely. Robots will be sent to dig for target materials and send them back towards Earth. They will ⓓbe programmed to explore the surface and identify materials, and be equipped for tasks such as drilling, collecting, and transporting. They may work
ⓔindependently or be controlled remotely from Earth. (나) Unfortunately, these types of robots have yet to be developed since the technology is still young. As technology continues to develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly emerge.

(가), (나) 문장을 <조건>에 따라 영작했을 때, 바르게 영작 한 것만을 <보기>에서 모두 고른 것은?
조건 1. (가) '충분한 물의 공급이 없다면'이라는 의미가 되도록 문장을 다시 쓸 것.
2. (나) '기술이 미숙하지 않았더라면'이라는 의미 가 되도록 문장을 다시 쓸 것.
보기 ㄱ. (가) Without sufficient water supplies, having a space station in orbit would not make space explorations easier.
ㄴ. (가) If it had not been for sufficient water supplies, a space station would have made space explorations much easier.
ㄷ. (나) If the technology had not been young, these types of robots would have been developed.
ㄹ. (나) If the technology were not young, these types of robots would be developed.
solution: ㄱ. 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정법 과거를 올바르게 영작했다. ㄷ. 과거 기술 발전에 대한 아쉬움을 가정법 과거완료로 올바르게 영작했다.

다음 중 빈칸 (가)와 (나)에 적절한 연결어로 짝 지어진 것은?
solution: (가)에서는 앞에서 설명한 우주 쓰레기 해결 노력에 추가적인 내용을 덧붙이고 있으므로 “게다가, 더욱이”라는 의미의 Moreover가 가장 적절하다. “researchers are also investigating …”에서 also가 사용된 점도 추가 설명의 흐름을 뒷받침한다. (나) 뒤에는 우주 쓰레기가 얼마나 위험한지를 보여 주는 구체적인 사례가 이어진다. “small pieces of junk … move at 6.7 kilometers per second”는 앞 문장의 위험성을 예시로 설명하는 내용이므로 “예를 들어”라는 의미의 For instance가 자연스럽다. 따라서 (가), (나)에 들어갈 연결어의 올바른 짝은 ⑤이다. ① Although : 양보 의미로 문맥에 맞지 않는다. ② Despite는 전치사이므로 뒤에 절이 올 수 없어 문법적으로 부적절하다. 또한 In addition to 뒤에는 명사(구)가 와야 한다. ③ Unlikely는 연결어가 아니며, In other words는 바꿔 말하기 의미이므로 적절하지 않다. ④ However는 역접 의미인데 앞뒤 내용이 대조 관계가 아니다. As a result는 결과 관계를 나타내므로 예시 문맥에 맞지 않는다.

Space: The Final Frontier The need to explore new frontiers like the Arctic and the American West may have been sparked by curiosity, but a major reason was to discover new resources. Without new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities. In the late 20th century, the Information Technology Revolution connected the world and transformed economies. Now, it seems that space is the latest frontier for entrepreneurs to explore. Finding new resources and exploring the unique environment ⓐare new opportunities for those who dare to take up the challenge. Asteroid Mining The solar system is composed of many rocks floating in space. The large ones are called planets, and the smaller ones are called asteroids. Research has shown that asteroids contain valuable resources like gold and rare earth elements. For example, one asteroid, 16 Psyche, is reported to consist mainly of gold and other precious metals,
ⓑwhich value is equal to billions of dollars per person on Earth. From a space explorers’ perspective, however, the most valuable resources from asteroids are neither valuable precious metals nor rare mineral deposits. That valuable resource could actually be water, and it seems to have been overlooked because it doesn’t seem as exciting as gold. Water is expensive to transport into space ⓒbecause its weight and volume. Having a space station with sufficient water supplies in orbit around Earth would make space explorations much easier. No one knows for sure ⓓwhat asteroid mining will look like, but it seems that robotic mining is most likely. Robots will be sent to dig for target materials and send them back towards Earth. They will be programmed to explore the surface and identify materials, and be equipped for tasks such as drilling, collecting, and transporting. They may work ⓔindependently or be controlled remotely from Earth. Unfortunately, these types of robots have yet to be developed since the technology is still young. As technology continues to develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly emerge.

Off-Earth Manufacturing Being on the International Space Station (ISS) is a unique experience. Astronauts live and work in microgravity, floating around instead of walking. Researchers get to see Earth from a completely new perspective, and they get to work on important scientific research in conditions that are different from Earth’s. Many manufacturers are interested in manufacturing in space because the quality of a lot of products ⓐmanufactured on Earth is influenced by temperature, pressure, radiation, and even the effects of gravity. Creating good conditions for certain types of manufacturing on Earth ⓑrequires the use of a lot of energy and resources, but those conditions occur naturally in space. Drugs, beauty and food products, and advanced materials are all potential candidates to be tested and ⓒproduced in space. For example, without the effects of gravity, products that require a uniform quality like cosmetics would be easier to mix. Other materials like 3D printed skin or muscle benefit from low pressure and gravity too. Although the sun’s radiation can be unhealthy for our skin, getting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere could also benefit the testing of products. For example, fabrics and skin creams could be tested for their ability to protect against solar radiation. Also, semiconductors and glass communication cables could be produced with higher purity and fewer faults. Space technology has advanced greatly, and it seems that the cost of running a space program and improving it
ⓓhave decreased substantially since ambitious entrepreneurs have joined the adventure. The conditions in space open up the possibility of manufacturing newer and better products. Challenges remain, but it’s not unreasonable to imagine sending a message from a device equipped with semiconductors that were produced in space. The space project will ultimately reach a point ⓔwhich adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system. The resources required to drive economic activity that have existed far beyond the reach of humanity are becoming much more reachable. The question is no longer about how; it’s about when.

body:

조건 1. without, her company, lose, his advice 를 활용하시오.
2. 9단어로 쓰시오.
→ _____ , _____ in the crisis.
answer: Without his advice, she would have lost her company
solution: 'without + 명사'는 'if it had not been for'를 대신하여 과거의 사실과 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 표현으로 사용된다. 이때 주절은 '주어 + would have + p.p.' 형태로 써서 이미 일어나지 않은 결과를 나타낸다. 따라서 'Without his advice, she would have lost her company in the crisis.'가 올바른 문장이 된다.

body: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
choices: Jenny speaks as though she had traveled the whole world.
Supposing it rained tomorrow, would you still go hiking?
If the traffic were to get worse, we would leave earlier.
If I had taken that job, I could be living in New York now.
They had known the truth, they would have told us immediately.
solution: ⑤는 조건절을 이끄는 접속사 If가 빠져 있다. 'If they had known the truth, they would have told us immediately.'로 고쳐야 한다. ①은 as though 뒤에 과거완료를 써서 주절보다 이전에 일어난 일을 나타내는 것으로 올바르다. ②는 Supposing이 If를 대신하는 가정법 표현으로 올바르다. ③은 If+주어+were to+동사원형으로 미래에 대한 가정법을 나타내는 것으로 올바르다. ④는 과거의 조건이 현재에 영향을 미치는 혼합가정법으로 올바르다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

the fire not damaged the warehouse, the workers wouldn't have lost their jobs.

body:
(A)~(C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현을 골라 짝지 은 것을 고르시오.
There is no doubt that online courses have value, but far too many students seem to enroll in them just to earn credits quickly. Their assignments are copied and submitted without much thought. This saves effort but doesn't allow them (A)[develop / to develop] critical thinking skills, which makes them perform worse rather than better. Such attempts (B)[to bypass / bypassing] the learning process have become common these days. Some students would do anything to graduate faster. However, earning credits doesn't necessarily mean being more educated. Unfortunately, our society appears (C)[to have / having] forgotten that learning is not only slow, it's also essential.
choices: to develop - to bypass - to have
solution: (A) allow + 목적어 + to부정사 구조이므로 to develop이 알맞다. (B) attempt(s) to + 동사원형의 형태이므로 to bypass가 알맞다. (C) appear to have + p.p.는 주절의 시점보다 앞선 일을 나타내는 완료부정사이므로 to have가 알맞다. 비상(홍) 4과 문법 정복 실전
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오.
The company seems _____ huge profits when it launched that product.
solution: ① to have earned가 정답이다. when it launched that product에서 수익을 올린 것은 현재의 seems보다 앞선 일이므로 완료부정사 to have + p.p.가 필요하다. 또한 The company가 수익을 올린 주체이고 earn huge profits에서 huge profits를 목적어로 취하므로 능동형 to have earned가 알맞다. ② to be는 의미상 huge profits를 목적어로 취할 수 없다. ③ to have been은 huge profits를 목적어로 취할 수 없어 문맥에 맞지 않는다. ④ to earn → to have earned 단순부정사 to earn은 주절의 동사와 같은 시점의 일을 나타내므로, 주절보다 앞선 과거의 일을 나타내는 문맥에는 적절하지 않다. ⑤ to have been earned는 수동형이므로 The company가 수익을 올린 주체인 문맥에 맞지 않는다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음을 읽고, 어법상 틀린 부분을 한 군데 찾아 바르게 고치시오.
Library catalog systems are a key component of research. Without them, it would have been virtually impossible to locate the resources we need. Library systems organize all the materials in the collection through digital databases or manual entries. When you use a library catalog, you're not actually browsing the physical shelves. Instead, you're searching a database of information that the library system has created. If you were to look at ten different library systems, you would see ten different ways to organize materials and ten different ways to search. That's why the same search on different library systems produces different results.
→
solution: Without them은 현재 사실과 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 표현이다. 도서관 목록 시스템이 현재 없다면 필요한 자료를 찾는 것이 사실상 불가능할 것이라는 의미이므로 가정법 과거의 would be가 알맞다. 따라서 과거 사실의 반대를 나타내는 would have been을 would be로 고쳐야 한다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 적절 한 것을 고르시오.
In small orchestras the same musician plays strings and woodwinds, and often the same person conducts rehearsals. And it is, of course, impossible for a musician of many instruments
(A)[to master / to be mastered] all of them. In large orchestras, on the other hand, because many conductors make demands on each instrument, one instrument alone - very often even less than a whole instrument - is enough to support a musician. For example, one musician can find it his job (B)[making / to make] arrangements for string sections, and another for brass sections. And there are places even where one musician earns a living by only composing melodies, another by arranging harmonies, and another by conducting performances. Such skilled workers may seem (C)[to use / to have used] classical techniques for a long time, but their specialization did result in more efficient and productive work.
choices: to be mastered - making - to have used
to master - to make - to use
to be mastered - to make - to use
to master - to make - to have used 교과서 문법 정복 실전 학습
solution: (A)는 '많은 악기를 다루는 음악가'가 그것들을 '통달하는' 주체이므로 능동의 to부정사 'to master'가 알맞다. (B)는 'find it + 목적어(job) + to부정사'의 가목적어 구문이므로 'to make'가 알맞다. (C)는 for a long time과 함께 과거부터 오랜 기간 고전적인 기법을 사용해 온 사실을 나타내며, 그 사용이 현재의 seem보다 앞서 시작된 일이므로 완료부정사 to have used가 알맞다. 따라서 정답은 ⑤이다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
주어진 문장과 같은 의미가 되도록 빈칸을 완성하시오.
(1) It seems that Mike is a good cook.
→Mike _____ . (2) That she passed the exam pleased her parents.
→It _____ .
answer: seems to be a good cook, pleased her parents that she passed the exam
solution: (1) 'It seems that + 주어 + 동사'는 'seem'의 주어를 that절의 주어로 바꾸어 'S + seem(s) to + 동사원형' 형태로 전환할 수 있다. 주어가 3인칭 단수 Mike이므로 'seems to be a good cook'이 된다. (2) that절이 문장의 주어로 쓰인 경우, 가주어 It을 문장 앞에 두고 진주어인 that절을 문장 뒤로 보내어 'It + 동사 + (목적어) + that절' 형태로 바꿀 수 있다. 따라서 'It pleased her parents that she passed the exam'이 된다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
ⓐI wish my sister would call me more often these days.
ⓑShould you need a ride, just let me know in advance.
ⓒIf I had saved more money, I would travel abroad this year.
ⓓIt hadn't been for the doctor's quick action, he wouldn't have survived.
ⓔIf I had known the password, we could have accessed the file.
solution: 정답은 ④ⓓ이다. 'If it had not been for'의 도치 표현은 'Had it not been for'로 써야 하는데 도치 없이 'It hadn't been for'로 쓰여 어법상 틀리다. ⓐwish 다음에 would를 사용해 상대방의 미래 행동에 대한 바람을 나타낸 것은 올바르다. ⓑ'Should you need'는 'If you should need'의 도치 구문으로 올바르다. ⓒ과거의 조건이 현재에 영향을 미치는 혼합 가정법으로 올바르게 사용되었다. ⓔ과거 사실에 반대되는 가정법 과거완료로 올바르다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
Building Angkor Wat was thought ⓐto have been a grand tribute to the king's power and the devotion of his people. ⓑIt was believing that the temple represented the center of the universe and would bring prosperity to the kingdom. Angkor Wat was the monument ⓒthrough which the king would successfully ⓓdemonstrate his connection to the divine. The location of the towers ⓔwas designed to match the layout of the Hindu cosmos.
solution: ⓑ was believing → was believed 비인칭 주어 It을 사용하여 ‘~라고 여겨졌다’라는 의미를 나타낼 때는 It was believed that ~의 수동태 형태를 써야 한다. 따라서 was believing을 was believed로 고쳐야 한다. ⓐ to have been은 주절의 시점보다 앞선 사실을 나타내는 완료부정사로 올바르다. ⓒ through which는 ‘그것을 통해’라는 의미로, 왕이 그 기념물을 통해 신과의 관계를 드러냈다는 문맥에 적절하다. ⓓ 조동사 would 뒤에 동사원형 demonstrate가 온 것은 올바르다. ⓔ 주어 The location이 단수이므로 단수동사 was가 올바르게 쓰였다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 문장을 완성하시오.
너의 조언이 없었더라면 나는 그 어려운 결정을 내릴 수 없었을텐데.
→ _____ your advice, I could not have made the difficult decision.
solution: 과거에 ‘너의 조언이 없었더라면’이라는 사실과 반대되는 상황을 가정하므로 If it had not been for의 도치형인 Had it not been for를 쓴다. 비상(홍) 4과 문법 정복 실전
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
choices: It is time the company updated its policies.
He reacted as if he were surprised by the news.
A responsible leader would admit the mistake.
But for the doctor's quick action, the patient couldn't have survived.
I were more organized, I could finish the project on time. 교과서 문법 정복 실전 학습
solution: ⑤ I were more organized → If I were more organized 현재 문장은 조건을 나타내는 접속사 If가 빠져 있으므로 If I were more organized, I could finish the project on time.으로 고쳐야 한다. ① It is time + 주어 + 과거동사는 ‘이제 ~해야 할 때이다’ 라는 뜻을 나타내므로 적절하다. ② as if 뒤에 현재 사실과 반대되는 상황을 나타내는 가정법 과거 were가 쓰였으므로 적절하다. ③ A responsible leader가 가정의 조건을 대신하여 ‘책임감 있는 지도자라면’이라는 의미를 나타내므로 적절하다. ④ But for the doctor's quick action은 If it had not been for the doctor's quick action과 같은 뜻으로 가정법 과거완료의 조건을 나타내므로 적절하다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
her constant encouragement, he would give up on his dream.
choices: If it had not been for
solution: 주절이 'would give up'으로 현재 사실에 반대되는 가정법 과거이므로 ⑤ 'If it were not for'가 정답이다. ① 'With'는 조건의 의미를 만들 수 없고, ② 'If'만으로는 문장이 성립하지 않는다. ③ 'Were to'는 미래에 대한 강한 가정을 나타내는 도치 구문으로 문맥에 맞지 않는다. ④ 'If it had not been for'는 가정법 과거완료로 주절에 'would have+p.p.'가 와야 하므로 시제가 일치하지 않는다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수를 고르시오.
ⓐSarah decided to study abroad next year.
ⓑThe report needs be finished by Friday.
ⓒShe was proud to having won the award.
ⓓIt's kind for him to help the elderly neighbor.
ⓔIt is hard to solve this puzzle in ten minutes.
solution: ⓑ needs be finished → needs to be finished need 뒤에 수동의 의미를 나타내려면 to be + p.p.를 써야 한다. ⓒ to having won → to have won 감정 형용사 proud 뒤에서 이미 완료된 일을 나타내므로 완료부정사 to have won이 알맞다. ⓓ for him → of him kind는 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사이므로 의미상 주어 앞에 of를 쓴다. ⓐ decided to study는 decide+to부정사 구조로 올바르다. ⓔ to solve는 가주어 It의 진주어로 쓰인 명사적 용법이다. 어법상 틀린 것은 ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓓ 세 개이므로 정답은 ③이다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것을 두 개 고르면?
More and more countries are becoming interested in exploring space these days. However, they seem to focus mainly on famous missions, while
ⓐignoring smaller research projects. But if scientists ⓑexamine the data carefully, they will find valuable insights. ⓒWere it not been for satellites and telescopes, for example, our understanding of the universe would be extremely limited. Every ⓓmission requires careful planning and funding. It is vital that agencies ⓔto continue supporting basic research.
① ⓐ
② ⓑ
③ ⓒ
④ ⓓ
⑤ ⓔ
solution: ③에서 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정법 과거에서 if가 생략된 도치 구문이므로 'Were it not for + 명사'의 형태가 되어야 한다. 따라서 'Were it not been for'에서 불필요한 'been'을 삭제하여 'Were it not for'로 고쳐야 한다. ⑤에서 'It is vital that + 주어' 뒤에는 원형부정사가 와야 하므로 'to continue'가 아니라 'continue'로 써야 한다. ① ignoring은 while 뒤에서 주절의 주어(they)와 일치하는 분사구문으로 올바르다. ② examine은 if절에 현재시제, 주절에 will을 쓰는 조건문 구조로 올바르다. ④ mission requires는 'every + 단수명사'가 단수동사와 함께 쓰인 것으로 올바르다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르시오.
choices: I didn't lock the door; otherwise, someone would have broken in.
If the rain hadn't stopped, the game would be canceled now.
Supposing you were in my position, what would you do?
She acts as if she were the only person who mattered.
Have you not called me, I would have missed the flight. 교과서 문법 정복 실전 학습
solution: if가 생략된 도치 가정법에서 결과절이 'would have missed'(가정법 과거완료)이므로 조건절도 이에 맞춰 'Had you not called me'로 써야 한다. 'Have'는 시제가 맞지 않는 틀린 표현이다. ①은 'otherwise'가 'if ~ had locked'를 대신하는 가정법 과거완료로 'would have broken'이 올바르다. ②는 'if + 과거완료, S + would + 동사원형(현재)'의 혼합 가정법으로 올바르다. ③ 은 'Supposing + 과거동사, would + 동사원형'의 가정법 과거로 올바르다. ④는 'as if + S + were'로 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거로 올바르다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은 모두 몇 개인가?
보기 (a) The store's goal is to increase online sales.
(b) It is necessary for visitors to check in at the front desk.
(c) He didn't know what time leave for the meeting.
(d) The plan is to renovate the building next month.
(e) The tourists seem enjoy the scenery today. (f) She didn't want her assistant to be overworked during the busy season.
solution: (c) 'what time leave'는 '의문사+to부정사' 구조가 되어야 하므로 'what time to leave'로 고쳐야 한다. (e) 'seem enjoy'는 'seem to + 동사원형' 구조가 되어야 하므로 'seem to enjoy'로 고쳐야 한다. 나머지 (a), (b), (d), (f)는 모두 올바른 to부정사 구문이다. (a) 'goal is to + 동사원형'은 주격보어로 쓰인 to부정사이다. (b) 'It is + 형용사 + for + 목적어 + to + 동사원형'은 가주어 it, 진주어 to부정사 구문이다. (d) 'be to + 동사원형'은 예정을 나타내는 올바른 표현이다. (f) 'want + 목적어 + to + 동사원형'은 목적격 보어로 쓰인 to부정사로 올바르다. 따라서 어법상 틀린 문장은 2개이다. 비상(홍) 4과 문법 정복 실전
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body: 다음 중 문장 전환이 바르게 된 것은?
choices: If John were more confident, he would speak up in meetings. →Were John more confident, he would speak up in meetings.
Without the coach's advice, we wouldn't have won the game. →If it were not for the coach's advice, we wouldn't have won the game.
As Lisa doesn't live nearby, she can't visit her grandmother often. →If Lisa lives nearby, she could visit her grandmother often.
If the workers had cooperated, they would have finished the project sooner. →As the workers had not cooperated, they didn't finish the project sooner.
I wish I could travel abroad this summer. →I'm sorry I could not travel abroad this summer.
solution: ① 'If + 주어 + were ~'의 가정법 과거 문장에서 if를 생략하고 주어와 were의 순서를 바꾼 도치 구문으로 올바른 전환이다. ② 주절이 'wouldn't have won'(과거 사실에 대한 가정) 이므로 without은 'If it had not been for'로 바꿔야 하는데, 현재를 나타내는 'If it were not for'를 사용해 시제가 맞지 않다. ③ As절은 현재 사실을 나타내므로 이를 가정법 과거로 바꾸면 동사는 과거형 'lived'가 되어야 하는데 현재형 'lives'를 사용해 틀렸다. ④ 가정법 과거완료(If had cooperated)를 직설법으로 바꿀 때는 실제 과거 사실을 나타내므로 단순과거 'didn't cooperate'를 써야 하는데, 과거완료 'had not cooperated'를 그대로 써서 틀렸다. ⑤ 'I wish + could'는 현재 이루지 못한 소망을 나타내므로 직설법으로 바꾸면 현재형 'I'm sorry I can't travel'이 되어야 하는데 과거형 'could not'을 사용해 틀렸다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고친 것을 고르시오.
Be we in a position to help, we would donate to the relief fund immediately.
choices: Were 교과서 문법 정복 실전 학습
solution: ⑤ if가 생략되고 주어와 동사가 도치된 가정법 과거 문장으로, be동사는 인칭에 상관없이 were 형태를 취해야 한다. ① Are는 현재형이라 가정법과 맞지 않는다. ② Being은 준동사이므로 도치된 동사 자리에 올 수 없다. ③ Have been은 현재완료로 시제가 어긋난다. ④ Had been은 가정법 과거완료에 쓰이는 형태로, 주절이 'would+동사원형'인 이 문장의 시제와 일치하지 않는다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
Thomas Reed was born in Dublin, Ireland, in 1788. He was a poet and playwright known for his melancholic writing style. His uncle wanted ⓐhim to become a clergyman, but he tried ⓑnot to suppress his creative urges. Instead, he pursued a literary career. At the age of eight, he could recite all of the poems he had heard his tutor read aloud. At age thirteen, he published his first poem in a local newspaper. His debut as a playwright came in 1808, and by 1815 he was appointed director of the Dublin Literary Society. Reed is remembered for his extensive writings, ⓒonly a few manuscripts remaining today. ⓓHaving been shaped by personal tragedy before, Reed cofounded the first theater in which playwrights performed tragedies rather than comedies in 1830. He is believed ⓔto write more than 80 poems during his lifetime, though most were destroyed in a flood. Reed died from illness in his home in 1850. He had published his last collection in London the same year, despite his declining health.
solution: ⓔ 'is believed'는 현재시제이지만, 시를 쓴 행위는 그보다 이전에 완료된 일이므로 단순부정사 'to write' 대신 완료부정사 'to have written'을 써야 한다. 따라서 ⓔ가 어법상 틀린 부분이다. ⓐ want + 목적어 + to부정사 구조로 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓑ try + not to + 동사원형 구조로 부정 부정사가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓒ 'Reed is remembered ~, only a few manuscripts remaining today'는 명사+분사의 절대구문으로 올바르다. ⓓ 'Having been shaped ~ before'는 주절보다 앞선 시점의 동작을 나타내는 완료분사구문으로 올바르게 쓰였다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하시오.
보기 encouragement / were / if / it / the teacher's / not / for 만약 선생님의 격려가 없다면, 학생들은 이 과목에서 향상을 보이지 않을 것이다.
→ _____ , the students wouldn't show improvement in this subject.
answer: If it were not for the teacher's encouragement
solution: 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정 상황을 나타내는 가정법 과거 표현이며 If it were not for + 명사 형태를 쓰므로, 정답은 If it were not for the teacher’s encouragement이다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
(A)~(C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현을 골라 짝지 은 것을 고르시오.
Language learners are often told that practice makes perfect. But the truth is that only correct practice will make you fluent. (A)[It were / Were it] not for consistent practice, you would make little progress. It doesn’t matter how many words you memorize if you (B)[are / were] memorizing them incorrectly. Too many students study alone without any feedback. Maybe they repeat the same words over and over again for weeks. Later, they may feel as if they have mastered them. But in reality, they may have simply been repeating the same mistakes over and over again. If this is the case, it would have been better if they had not studied at all! So it’s time you (C)[study / studied] correctly!
choices: It were - are - studied 교과서 문법 정복 실전 학습
solution: (A) if가 생략된 가정법 구문에서는 주어와 동사가 도치되므로 Were it이 알맞다. (B) 실제로 일어날 수 있는 일반적인 상황을 조건으로 나타내므로 현재진행형 are memorizing이 알맞다. (C) It’s time + 주어 + 과거시제는 ‘이제 ~할 때이다’라는 의미이므로 studied가 알맞다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
두 문장이 같은 의미가 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
It seems that Sarah finished her homework yesterday. = Sarah seems _____ her homework yesterday.
solution: 문장의 동사인 'seems'보다 이전을 나타내려면 to부정사의 완료형인 'to have finished'를 쓴다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 글을 읽고, 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 번호를 모두 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
The risks of the chemical
① weren't identified because it wasn't tested on aquatic life.
② It had been, the results might have revealed its impact on marine ecosystems. This is one reason some scientists insist that environmental testing
③ expanded to include rivers. → →
answer: ②→ Had it been, ③→ expand
solution: if가 생략된 가정법 과거완료에서는 'Had + 주어 + p.p.'로 도치하므로 'It had been'을 'Had it been'으로 고쳐야 한다. 또한 'insist'가 당위의 의미로 쓰였으므로 that절에는 동사원형을 써서 'expanded'를 'expand'로 고쳐야 한다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 문장을 읽고, 밑줄 친 부분에 유의하여 to부정사를 이 용한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
It seems that she decided to donate all her savings to charity.
→
answer: She seems to have decided to donate all her savings to charity.
solution: 'It seems that + 주어 + 과거동사'는 'S + seem(s) + to have + p.p.'로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. that절의 시점이 주절보다 앞선 과거이므로 완료부정사(to have decided)를 사용한다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
우리말과 같은 의미가 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
그들이 그 비행기를 놓쳤더라면 그들은 공항에서 하룻밤을 보냈을 것이다.
_____ the plane, they would have spent the night at the airport.
solution: 가정법 문장의 if절에서 if가 생략되면 주어와 (조)동사의 도치가 일어난다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞게 배열하여 주어진 우리말을 영 작하시오. (단, 반드시 to부정사를 사용할 것)
Sarah는 새로운 환경에 적응하지 못하는 것 같다. (adapt to, Sarah, the new, does not, environment, seem)
→ _____ ​.
answer: Sarah does not seem to adapt to the new environment
solution: seem to + 동사원형' 구조에서 to 부정사은 보어 역할을 하는 형용사적 용법으로, 'Sarah does not seem to adapt'의 형태로 부정문을 만들 수 있다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수를 고르시오.
• Without smartphones, communication ⓐwould have been much more difficult nowadays.
• If he had taken the medicine, he ⓑwould have recovered from his illness sooner.
• But for the scholarship, she ⓒcan't afford to attend university.
• I wish the weather ⓓwere warmer so we could go swimming now.
• Otherwise, the students ⓔwould understand the lesson better.
• If the team ⓕpracticed more last season, they would be champions today.
solution: ⓐ would have been → would be(현재 상황에 대한 가정이므로 가정법 과거 형태를 써야 한다.), ⓒ can't afford → couldn't afford(But for을 사용한 가정법이므로 조동사의 과거형을 사용해야 한다.), ⓕ practiced → had practiced(과거에 대한 가정을 나타내므로 practiced를 과거 완료 had practiced로 고쳐야 한다.) 따라서 틀린 것은 3개이다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수를 고르시오.
• But for modern medicine, many diseases
ⓐwould be incurable today.
• If I had known about the party, I ⓑwould attend it yesterday.
• Without proper training, the athletes ⓒwouldn't perform well in competitions.
• She wishes she ⓓhad more free time to spend with her children.
• Otherwise, the company ⓔwould have failed to meet its quarterly goals today.
• If they ⓕinvested in technology early, they would be market leaders now.
solution: ⓑwould attend → would have attended (과거 사실에 대한 가정이므로 would have p.p.), ⓔ would have failed → would fail (부사 today를 보아 현재 상황에 대한 가정을 나타내므로 would + 동사원형), ⓕ 혼합가정법을 사용하여 기술에 일찍 투자를 했다면 현재 시장의 리더가 될 것이라는 내용을 나타낸다. 따라서 invested를 과거 완료 had invested로 고쳐야 한다. 따라서 틀린 것은 3개이다. 비상(홍) 4과 문법 정복 실전
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body: 다음 중 문장 전환이 바르게 된 것은?
choices: Without her guidance, I wouldn't have finished the painting in time. →If it were not for her guidance, I wouldn't have finished the painting in time.
If the company had invested earlier, it would have grown much faster. →As the company had not invested earlier, it didn't grow much faster.
As Sam doesn't have enough money, he can't buy the ticket. →If Sam has enough money, he could buy the ticket.
I wish I could join the trip next week. →I'm sorry I could not join the trip next week.
If she were braver, she would try the new challenge. →Were she braver, she would try the new challenge.
solution: ⑤ 'If + 주어 + were ~'의 가정법 과거 문장에서 if를 생략하고 주어와 were의 순서를 바꾼 도치 구문으로 올바른 전환이다. ① 주절이 'wouldn't have finished'(과거 사실에 대한 가정)이므로 without은 'If it had not been for'로 바꿔야 하는데, 현재를 나타내는 'If it were not for'를 사용해 시제가 맞지 않다. ② 가정법 과거완료(If had invested)를 직설법으로 바꿀 때는 실제 과거 사실을 나타내므로 단순과거 'didn't invest'를 써야 하는데, 과거완료 'had not invested'를 그대로 써서 틀렸다. ③ As절은 현재 사실을 나타내므로 이를 가정법 과거로 바꾸면 동사는 과거형 'had'가 되어야 하는데 현재형 'has'를 사용해 틀렸다. ④ 'I wish + could'는 현재 이루지 못한 소망을 나타내므로 직설법으로 바꾸면 현재형 'I'm sorry I can't join'이 되어야 하는데 과거형 'could not'을 사용해 틀렸다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분을 찾아 쓰고 바르게 고치시오.
Elephants roam widely in search of food and interact through complex vocalizations. In fact, elephants display remarkable memory; their brains actually appear to expand over the last few million years. _____ →
answer: appear to expand → appear to have expanded
solution: over the last few million years'는 과거부터 현재까지의 변화를 나타내므로 완료부정사 'to have expanded'가 알맞다. 따라서 'appear to expand'를 'appear to have expanded'로 고쳐야 한다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳지 않은 것을 모두 고르면?
Since the beginning of the space age in the 1950s, thousands of rockets and satellites
ⓐlaunched into space. Most have functioned as they were designed to, but over time, some machines have broken down and remained floating around in space because they are difficult to bring back. Dead satellites, ⓑusing rocket parts, and small pieces of dirt are in orbit. Those objects left ⓒunattended in space are collectively referred to as space junk. The presence of space junk significantly increases risks to space activities and the safety of astronauts. For example, small pieces of junk might not ⓓseem like a big issue, but they move at 6.7 kilometers per second. At that speed, even a small piece of metal can seriously harm satellites ⓔproviding services across the world. In addition, each crash has the potential to generate more space junk. Without active efforts to remove the junk, traveling in space would be extremely dangerous.
solution: ⓐ launched → have been launched Since ~ 구문으로 보아 과거부터 현재까지 이어지는 일을 나타내며, 주어인 rockets and satellites는 '발사되는' 수동의 대상이므로, 현재완료 수동인 'have been launched'로 고쳐야 한다. ⓑ using → used be동사 are의 주어를 이루는 명사구 나열 구조로, rocket parts를 수식하며 '사용된'이라는 수동의 의미를 나타내야 하므로, 현재분사 using이 아니라 과거분사 used가 되어야 한다. ⓒ 과거분사 left 뒤에서 목적격 보어로 쓰이던 형용사가 남아있는 구조(leave + 목적어 + unattended)로, 물체들이 '방치된' 상태를 나타내므로 unattended의 쓰임은 적절하다. ⓓ 조동사 might 뒤에 동사원형 seem이 올바르게 쓰였고, seem은 뒤에 형용사를 바로 취하지만, 뒤에 명사구(a big issue)가 올 때는 전치사 like를 함께 써야 하므로 seem like의 쓰임은 적절하다. ⓔ 명사 satellites를 수식하며 '서비스를 제공하는'이라는 능동의 의미를 나타내는 현재분사이므로 providing의 쓰임은 적절하다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 글의 네모 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 어법상 가장 적절한 것을 짝지은 것은?
Space technology has advanced greatly, and it seems that the cost of running a space program and improving it has decreased substantially since ambitious entrepreneurs have joined the adventure. The conditions in space open up the possibility of (A)[manufacturing / manufacture] newer and better products. Challenges remain, but it's not unreasonable to imagine sending a message from a device equipped with semiconductors that (B)[was / were] produced in space. The space project will ultimately reach a point (C)[where / which] adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system. The resources required to drive economic activity that have existed far beyond the reach of humanity are becoming much more reachable. The question is no longer about how; it's about when.
solution: (A) 전치사 of의 목적어 자리이므로 동명사 manufacturing이 알맞다. (B) 주격 관계대명사 that의 선행사가 복수명사인 semiconductors이므로 복수동사 were가 알맞다. (C) 선행사 a point를 수식하며 뒤에 완전한 문장이 이어지므로 관계부사 where가 알맞다. 따라서, 정답은 ② manufacturing - were - where 가 가장 알맞다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳지 않은 것을 2개의 기호를 쓰고 바르게 고치시오.
Space technology has advanced greatly, and the cost of running a space program and improving it
ⓐseem to decrease substantially since ambitious entrepreneurs ⓑhave joined the adventure. The conditions in space open up the possibility of
ⓒmanufacturing newer and better products. Challenges remain, but it’s not unreasonable to imagine sending a message from a device equipped with semiconductors that were produced in space. The space project will
ⓓultimate reach a point ⓔwhere adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system. The resources required to drive economic activity that have existed far beyond the reach of humanity are becoming much more reachable. The question is no longer about how; it’s about when. ( ), _____ → ( ), _____ → 실전 학습
solution: ⓐ seem → seems 주어가 the cost(단수)이므로, 'of running a space program and improving it(전치사구)'은 명사를 수식하는 수식어일 뿐 진짜 주어가 아니다. 따라서 동사도 단수형 seems가 되어야 한다. ⓓ ultimate → ultimately 동사 reach를 수식해야 하므로 형용사 ultimate가 아니라 부사 ultimately가 되어야 한다. 비상(홍) 4과 문법 정복 실전
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 문법적 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다 른 하나는?
Being on the International Space Station (ISS) is a unique experience. Astronauts live and work in microgravity, ⓐfloating around instead of
ⓑwalking. Researchers get to see Earth from a completely new perspective, and they get to work on important scientific research in conditions that are different from Earth’s. Many manufacturers are interested in ⓒmanufacturing in space because the quality of a lot of products manufactured on Earth is influenced by temperature, pressure, radiation, and even the effects of gravity.
ⓓCreating good conditions for certain types of manufacturing on Earth requires the use of a lot of energy and resources, but those conditions occur naturally in space. Drugs, beauty and food products, and advanced materials are all potential candidates to be tested and produced in space. For example, without the effects of gravity, products that require a uniform quality like cosmetics would be easier to mix. Other materials like 3D printed skin or muscle benefit from low pressure and gravity too. Although the sun’s radiation can be unhealthy for our skin, ⓔgetting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere could also benefit the testing of products. For example, fabrics and skin creams could be tested for their ability to protect against solar radiation. Also, semiconductors and glass communication cables could be produced with higher purity and fewer faults.
solution: ⓐ '떠다니면서'라는 부대상황을 나타내는 현재분사(분사구문) 로 쓰였다. ⓑ 전치사 instead of의 목적어 역할을 하는 동명사로 쓰였다. ⓒ 전치사 in의 목적어 역할을 하는 동명사로 쓰였다 (interested in manufacturing). ⓓ 문장의 주어 역할을 하는 동명사로 쓰였다. ⓔ 문장의 주어 역할을 하는 동명사로 쓰였다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
No one knows for sure what asteroid mining will look like, but it seems that robotic mining ⓐwas most likely. Robots will be sent to dig for target materials and send them back towards Earth. They will be programmed to explore the surface and identify materials, and ⓑbe equipped for tasks such as drilling, collecting, and transporting. They may work independently or ⓒcontrolled remotely from Earth. Unfortunately, these types of robots ⓓhas yet to be developed since the technology is still young. As technology continues to develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly ⓔemerging.
solution: ⓑ 조동사 will 뒤에 be programmed와 등위접속사 and로 연결되어 수동태 동사원형인 be equipped의 쓰임은 적절하다. 따라서, 정답은 ②가 가장 알맞다. ⓐ was → is seems 뒤에서 현재 상황에 대한 추측을 나타내야 하는 문맥이므로, was가 아니라 현재시제 is가 되어야 한다. ⓒ controlled → be controlled 주어인 They(로봇)는 지구에서 원격 제어되는 수동의 대상이므로, 조동사 may 뒤에 수동태 형태인 be controlled가 되어야 한다. ⓓ has → have 주어 these types of robots가 복수이므로 has가 아니라 have가 되어야 한다. ⓔ emerging → emerge 조동사 will 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 emerging이 아니라 emerge가 되어야 한다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳지 않은 것을 골라 기호를 쓰고 바르게 고치시오.
The solar system ⓐis composed of many rocks floating in space. The large ones are ⓑcalled planets, and the smaller ones are called asteroids. Research has shown that asteroids contain valuable resources like gold and rare earth elements. For example, one asteroid, 16 Psyche, is reported ⓒto have consisted mainly of gold and other precious metals, whose value is equal to billions of dollars per person on Earth. From a space explorers’ perspective, however, the most valuable resources from asteroids are neither valuable precious metals ⓓnor rare mineral deposits. That valuable resource could actually be water, and it seems to have been overlooked because it doesn’t seem ⓔas exciting as gold. Water is expensive to transport into space due to its weight and volume. Having a space station with sufficient water supplies in orbit around Earth would make space explorations much easier. ( ), _____ →
solution: ⓒ to have consisted → to consist is reported는 현재시제이고, to have consisted는 그보다 앞선 과거 시점의 일(과거의 소행성 구성)을 나타내는 완료부정사이다. 그런데 뒤에 이어지는 whose value is equal to ~는 현재에도 유효한 가치 평가를 나타내므로, 이는 '~였다고 보고된다'는 과거의 완료된 사실이 아니라 '현재 ~로 구성되어 있다고 보고된다'는 현재의 상태를 나타내야 한다. 따라서 완료부정사 to have consisted가 아니라 단순부정사 to consist로 고쳐야 알맞다. ⓐ 태양계가 '구성되어 있다'는 수동의 의미이므로 is composed of의 쓰임은 적절하다. ⓑ 큰 것들이 행성으로 '불린다'는 수동의 의미이므로 called의 쓰임은 적절하다. ⓓ neither A nor B 구문에서 nor의 쓰임은 적절하다. ⓔ 2형식 동사 seem의 보어로 형용사가 오는 자리이며, 주어인 it(water)이 흥미를 유발하는 대상이므로 현재분사 exciting을 활용한 원급 비교(as + 원급 + as) 구문이 적절하게 쓰였다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고르면?
The need ⓐto explore new frontiers like the Arctic and the American West may have been sparked by curiosity, but a major reason was ⓑto discover new resources. Without new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not ⓒlead to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities. In the late 20th century, the Information Technology Revolution connected the world and transformed economies. Now, it seems that space ⓓwas the latest frontier for entrepreneurs to explore. Finding new resources and exploring the unique environment are new opportunities for those
ⓔthat dare ⓕtaking up the challenge.
solution: ⓐ need를 수식하는 형용사적 용법의 to부정사로 쓰였다. ⓑ was의 주격보어 역할을 하는 명사적 용법의 to부정사로 쓰였다. ⓔ 선행사 those(사람들)를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사로 쓰였다. ⓒ lead → have led Without은 '~이 없었다면'이라는 과거 사실에 대한 가정을 나타내고, 19세기 산업혁명이라는 이미 지나간 역사적 사실을 다루므로 'would not have led'라는 가정법 과거완료 형태가 되어야 한다. ⓓ was → is 문장 앞의 Now(지금)가 현재 시점을 나타내므로, 뒤의 동사도 현재시제 is가 되어야 한다. ⓕ taking → take (또는 to take) dare는 일반동사로 쓰일 때 to부정사, 조동사로 쓰일 때 원형부정사를 취하므로, 동명사 taking이 아니라 take 또는 to take가 되어야 한다. 따라서, ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓔ 세 곳 모두 어법상 옳으므로, 이를 모두 포함한 조합인 ②가 가장 알맞다. 비상(홍) 4과 문법 정복 실전
