body:
다음 밑줄 친 문장과 바꾸어 쓸 수 없는 것을 모두 고르면?
(정답 2개)
The need to explore new frontiers like the Arctic and the American West may have been sparked by curiosity, but a major reason was to discover new resources. Without new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities. In the late 20th century, the Information Technology Revolution connected the world and transformed economies. Now, it seems that space is the latest frontier for entrepreneurs to explore. Finding new resources and exploring the unique environment are new opportunities for those who dare to take up the challenge.
① But for new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities.
② If it had not been for new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities.
③ Had it not been for new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities.
④ If new resources and technology were not, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities.
⑤ Had not it been new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and the growth of cities.
solution: ④ If new resources and technology were not는 가정법 과거(were)의 형태이므로, 주절의 과거완료(would not have led)와 시제가 어긋난다. 과거 사실의 반대를 가정하려면 If new resources and technology had not existed(been available) 등 가정법 과거완료로 써야 하므로 바꿔 쓸 수 없다. ⑤ Had it not been for 의 형태로 쓰여야 한다. ① But for는 '~이 없었다면'이라는 뜻의 가정법 관용 표현으로, Without과 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. ② If it had not been for는 '~이 없었다면'이라는 뜻의 가정법 과거완료 관용 표현으로, Without과 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. ③ Had it not been for는 ②의 if가 생략되고 도치된 형태로, Without과 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. 따라서, 정답은 ④, ⑤가 가장 알맞다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
밑줄 친 부분 중 어법 상 어색한 것을 모두 찾아 기호를 적고 옳게 고쳐 쓰시오.
Off-Earth Manufacturing Being on the International Space Station (ISS) is a unique experience. Astronauts live and work in microgravity, ⓐfloating around instead of walking. Researchers get to see Earth from a completely new perspective, and they get to work on important scientific research in conditions that are different from Earth's. Many manufacturers are interested in manufacturing in space because the quality of a lot of products ⓑmanufactured on Earth is influenced by temperature, pressure, radiation, and even the effects of gravity. Creating good conditions for certain types of manufacturing on Earth requires the use of a lot of energy and resources, but those conditions occur naturally in space. Drugs, beauty and food products, and advanced materials are all potential candidates to be tested and produced in space. For example, without the effects of gravity, products that require a uniform quality like cosmetics would be easier ⓒto mixing. Other materials like 3D printed skin or muscle benefit from low pressure and gravity too. Although the sun's radiation can be unhealthy for our skin, getting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere could also benefit the testing of products. For example, fabrics and skin creams could be tested for their ability to protect against solar radiation. Also, semiconductors and glass communication cables could be produced with higher purity and fewer faults. 실전 학습 Space technology has advanced greatly, and it seems that the cost of running a space program and improving it has decreased substantially since ambitious entrepreneurs have joined the adventure. The conditions in space open up the possibility of manufacturing newer and better products. Challenges remain, but it's not unreasonable to imagine sending a message from a device ⓓequipping with semiconductors that were produced in space. The space project will ultimately reach a point ⓔwhich adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system. The resources required to drive economic activity that have existed far beyond the reach of humanity are becoming much more reachable. The question is no longer about how; it's about when.
_____ , _____ → _____ , _____ → _____ , _____ →
answer: ⓒ to mixing → to mix, ⓓ equipping with → equipped with, ⓔ which → where
solution: ⓒ to mixing → to mix "be easier to mix"는 「형용사 + to-부정사」 구문으로, to 뒤에는 반드시 동사원형이 와야 한다. to mixing은 to 뒤에 동명사(-ing)가 온 잘못된 형태이므로 to mix로 고쳐야 한다. ⓓ equipping with → equipped with 선행사 "a device"는 반도체를 장착하는 주체가 아니라 반도체가 장착되는 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 equipped with로 수식해야 한다. 현재분사 equipping with는 능동의 의미를 나타내므로 문맥에 맞지 않는다. ⓔ which → where 선행사 "a point"는 장소(지점)를 나타내는 명사이며, 뒤에 이어지는 절 "adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system"은 완전한 절이다. 완전한 절을 이끌며 장소 선행사를 수식할 때는 관계부사 where를 써야 한다. 관계대명사 which를 쓰면 절 내에 빠진 성분이 있어야 하는데 이 절은 문법적으로 완전하므로 which는 틀렸다. ⓐ floating: "Astronauts live and work in microgravity, floating around instead of walking"에서 floating은 분사구문으로, 주어인 Astronauts가 직접 떠다니는 행위를 하는 것이므로 능동의 현재분사 floating이 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓑ manufactured: "products manufactured on Earth"에서 products는 제조되는 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 manufactured가 올바르게 쓰였다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

solution: ② 'the quality of a lot of products manufactured on Earth'가 주어이고, 'is influenced by'는 수동태로 올바르게 쓰였다. 온도, 압력, 방사선, 중력의 영향에 의해 제품의 질이 '영향을 받는' 것이므로 수동태가 적절하며, 어법상 옳다. 따라서 ②가 정답이다. ① floated → floating 'Astronauts live and work in microgravity'에 이어지는 분사구문으로, 주어인 Astronauts가 능동적으로 '떠다니는' 행위를 하고 있으므로 현재분사 floating이 와야 한다. 과거분사 floated는 수동의 의미를 나타내므로 문맥상 부적절하다. ③ natural → naturally 동사 'occur'를 수식하는 부사가 필요한 자리이다. 형용사 natural은 동사를 수식할 수 없으므로, 부사형인 naturally로 고쳐야 한다. ④ test → tested 'could be tested'는 수동태 구문으로, 'fabrics and skin creams'가 테스트를 '받는' 대상이므로 과거분사 tested가 와야 한다. 동사원형 test를 쓰면 'could be test'가 되어 수동태 구조가 파괴되므로 틀렸다. ⑤ that has → that have 관계대명사 that의 선행사는 복수 명사 'The resources'이므로, 관계사절의 동사도 복수형인 have를 써야 한다. 단수형 has는 수 일치 오류이다. 비상(홍) 4과 문법 정복 실전

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
Since the beginning of the space age in the 1950s, thousands of rockets and satellites have been launched into space. Most have functioned as they were ⓐdesigning to, but over time, some machines have broken down and remain floating around in space because they are difficult to bring back. Dead satellites, used rocket parts, and small pieces of dirt are in orbit. Those objects left unattended in space are collectively referred to as space junk. The presence of space junk significantly ⓑincrease risks to space activities and the safety of astronauts. For example, small pieces of junk might not seem like a big issue, but they move at 6.7 kilometers per second. At that speed, even a small piece of metal can seriously harm satellites ⓒthat provide services across the world. In addition, each crash has the potential to generate more space junk. Without active efforts to remove the junk, traveling in space would be extremely dangerous. To ensure the safe operation of space activities, it is critical ⓓaddressing the space junk problem. Various space institutions and even entrepreneurs are actively working on solutions to reduce the amount of space junk in orbit. These efforts include the development of innovative technologies such as robotic arms to capture and remove large pieces of space junk as well as the improvement of tracking systems to better avoid space junk. What's more, researchers are also investigating recycling existing space junk to reduce its impact on future space activities. This approach not only helps in reducing the space junk problem but also
ⓔpromoting sustainability in space exploration. The long journey toward finding a solution to the space junk problem has only just begun.
solution: ③이 정답이다. "satellites"가 선행사인 주격 관계대명사 that이 이끄는 절에서 선행사가 복수명사 satellites이므로 동사도 복수형인 provide가 올바르게 쓰였다. 따라서 ③이 정답이다. ① designing to → designed to "Most have functioned as they were designing to"에서 they(machines)는 누군가에 의해 설계되는 대상이므로, 능동형 현재분사 designing이 아니라 수동의 과거분사 designed가 쓰여야 한다. ② increase → increases 문장의 주어는 "The presence"로 단수명사구이다. 따라서 동사도 단수형인 increases가 쓰여야 하는데, increase로 표기되어 수 일치 오류가 있다. ④ addressing → to address "it is critical " 구문에서 it은 가주어이고 진주어는 to부정사로 나타내야 한다. 동명사 addressing은 이 구문에서 진주어 역할을 할 수 없으므로 to address로 고쳐야 한다. ⑤ promoting → promotes "not only A but also B" 병렬구조에서 A에 해당하는 부분이 동사구 "helps in reducing"(3인칭 단수 현재) 이므로, B에 해당하는 부분도 동사 형태인 promotes가 쓰여야 한다. 현재분사 promoting은 병렬구조를 깨뜨리므로 오류이다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

solution: ③ who provide → that provide (또는 which provide) 선행사 'satellites'는 사물이므로 사람을 가리키는 주격 관계대명사 who를 쓸 수 없다. 사물 선행사를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 that 또는 which로 고쳐야 한다. 따라서 ③이 정답이다. ① 'Most have functioned as they were designed to'에서 as는 '~하는 대로, ~처럼'의 의미를 가진 접속사로 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 'Those objects left unattended in space are collectively referred to as space junk'에서 referred는 수동태 구문 'be referred to as(~로 불리다)'의 과거분사로 올바르게 쓰였다. ④ 'has the potential to generate'에서 to generate는 'the potential'을 수식하는 to부정사(형용사적 용법)로 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 'not only helps in reducing the space junk problem but also promotes sustainability'에서 promotes는 'but also'에 연결되어 앞의 helps와 병렬을 이루는 3인칭 단수 현재형 동사로 올바르게 쓰였다. 비상(홍) 4과 문법 정복 실전

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
Asteroid Mining The solar system is composed of many rocks floating in space. The large ones are called planets, and the smaller ones are called asteroids. Research has shown that asteroids contain valuable resources like gold and rare earth elements. For example, one asteroid, 16 Psyche, is reported to consist mainly of gold and other precious metals, ⓐwhich value is equal to billions of dollars per person on Earth. From a space explorers' perspective, however, the most valuable resources from asteroids are neither valuable precious metals nor rare mineral deposits. That valuable resource could actually be water, and it seems ⓑto have been overlooked because it doesn't seem as exciting as gold. Water is expensive to transport into space due to its weight and volume. ⓒHave a space station with sufficient water supplies in orbit around Earth would make space explorations much easier. 실전 학습 No one knows for sure what asteroid mining will look like, but it seems that robotic mining is most likely. Robots will be sent to ⓓdigging for target materials and send them back towards Earth.
They will be programmed to explore the surface and identify materials, and be equipped for tasks such as drilling, collecting, and transporting. They may work independently or be controlled remotely from Earth. Unfortunately, these types of robots have yet ⓔbeing developed since the technology is still young. As technology continues to develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly emerge.
solution: ② 'it seems to have been overlooked'에서 ⓑ 'to have'는 완료 부정사 수동태 구조('seems + to have been p.p.')의 일부로, 주절의 시제보다 앞선 시점에 '간과되어 왔음'을 나타낸다. seem 뒤에 완료 부정사를 쓰는 것은 어법상 옳으므로 따라서 ②가 정답이다. ① which → whose 'precious metals'의 가치(value)가 수십억 달러에 달한다는 내용으로, 앞 선행사 'precious metals'의 소유 관계를 나타내는 소유격 관계대명사 whose가 필요하다. which는 소유격으로 쓸 수 없으므로 which를 whose로 고쳐야 한다. ③ Have → Having 'a space station ... would make space explorations much easier'라는 주절이 이어지므로, 문장의 주어 자리에는 동명사구가 와야 한다. 동사원형 Have는 주어 자리에 올 수 없으므로 동명사 Having으로 고쳐야 한다. ④ digging → dig 'be sent to dig'에서 'to'는 부정사를 이끄는 to이므로 뒤에 동사원형이 와야 한다. 'be sent to + 동사원형' 구조에서 digging(동명사/현재분사)은 올 수 없으므로 dig으로 고쳐야 한다. ⑤ being → to be 'have yet to-v'는 '아직 ~하지 못하다'라는 의미의 관용 표현으로, yet 뒤에 반드시 to부정사가 와야 한다. being developed는 이 구조에 맞지 않으므로 to be developed로 고쳐야 한다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

solution: ③ overlooking → overlooked 'it seems to have been overlooking'에서 주어 it(= water)은 '간과되는' 대상이지 스스로 무언가를 '간과하는' 주체가 아니다. 따라서 완료 부정사 수동태 구조인 'to have been + 과거분사'가 되어야 하므로, 현재분사 overlooking을 과거분사 overlooked로 고쳐야 한다. 따라서 ③이 정답이다. ① 'rocks'를 후치 수식하는 현재분사 floating이 올바르게 쓰였다. rocks가 능동적으로 '떠 있는' 것이므로 현재분사 형태가 적절하다. ② 선행사 'gold and other precious metals'를 받는 소유격 관계대명사 whose가 올바르게 쓰였다. 관계절 안에서 'whose value'가 주어 역할을 한다. ④ 'Having a space station with sufficient water supplies in orbit around Earth'는 동명사구가 문장의 주어로 쓰인 것으로, would make의 주어가 되므로 Having이 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 수동태 구조 'be controlled'를 수식하는 부사 remotely가 올바르게 쓰였다. 형용사가 아닌 부사로 동사를 수식하는 것이 적절하다. 비상(홍) 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
Off-Earth Manufacturing Being on the International Space Station (ISS) is a unique experience. Astronauts live and work in microgravity, ⓐfloating around instead of walking. Researchers get to see Earth from a completely new perspective, and they get to work on important scientific research in conditions that are different from Earth's. Many manufacturers are interested in manufacturing in space because the quality of a lot of products manufactured on Earth is influenced by temperature, pressure, radiation, and even the effects of gravity. Creating good conditions for certain types of manufacturing on Earth requires the use of a lot of energy and resources, but those conditions occur naturally in space. Drugs, beauty and food products, and advanced materials are all potential candidates ⓑto be tested and produced in space. For example, without the effects of gravity, products that require a uniform quality like cosmetics would be easier to mix. Other materials like 3D printed skin or muscle benefit from low pressure and gravity too. Although the sun's radiation can be unhealthy for our skin, getting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere could also ⓒbenefit the testing of products. For example, fabrics and skin creams could be tested for their ability to protect against solar radiation. Also, semiconductors and glass communication cables could be produced with higher purity and fewer faults. Space technology has advanced greatly, and it seems that the cost of running a space program and improving it ⓓhad decreased substantially since ambitious entrepreneurs have joined the adventure. The conditions in space open up the possibility of manufacturing newer and better products. Challenges remain, but it's not unreasonable to imagine sending a message from a device equipped with semiconductors that were produced in space. The space project will ultimately reach a point where adventurous minds and their technological innovations will be able to travel safely to stars beyond the solar system. The resources required to drive economic activity
ⓔthat have existed far beyond the reach of humanity are becoming much more reachable. The question is no longer about how; it's about when. 실전 학습
solution: ④ had decreased → has decreased 현재 시제 동사 'seems'가 이끄는 that절 안에서, 'since'(~ 이후로)는 과거의 특정 시점부터 현재까지 이어지는 상황을 나타내므로 현재완료 시제를 요구한다. 따라서 과거완료 had decreased는 어법상 틀리며, 현재완료인 has decreased로 고쳐야 한다. 주절의 시제가 현재('seems') 이고 since절이 현재완료('have joined')로 쓰인 것도 현재완료가 적절함을 뒷받침한다. 따라서 ④가 정답이다. ① floating은 'Astronauts live and work in microgravity'에 이어지는 분사구문으로, 주어인 Astronauts가 직접 떠다니는 행위를 하므로 능동의 현재분사 floating이 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 'candidates' 뒤에는 자격·용도를 나타내는 to부정사가 이어지며, 'Drugs, beauty and food products, and advanced materials'가 시험되고 생산되는 대상이므로 수동태 부정사 to be가 올바르게 쓰였다. ③ 'getting away from the protective effects of the atmosphere'라는 동명사구가 주어이고, 'benefit'은 '~에 이롭다'는 의미의 타동사로 뒤에 'the testing of products'를 목적어로 취하고 있으므로 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 관계대명사 that은 선행사 'The resources'(복수)를 받아 주격 관계대명사로 쓰였으며, 복수 동사 have와 수가 일치하므로 that have가 올바르게 쓰였다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 찾아 기호를 적고 옳게 고쳐 쓰시오.
Asteroid Mining The solar system is composed of many rocks floating in space. The large ones are ⓐcalled planets, and the smaller ones are called asteroids. Research has shown that asteroids contain valuable resources like gold and rare earth elements. For example, one asteroid, 16 Psyche, is reported to consist mainly of gold and other precious metals, ⓑwhich value is equal to billions of dollars per person on Earth. From a space explorers' perspective, however, the most valuable resources from asteroids are neither valuable precious metals nor rare mineral deposits. That valuable resource could actually be water, and it seems ⓒto have overlooked because it doesn't seem as exciting as gold. Water is expensive to transport into space due to its weight and volume. Having a space station with sufficient water supplies in orbit around Earth would make space explorations much easier. No one knows for sure what asteroid mining will look like, but it seems that robotic mining is most likely. Robots will ⓓbe sent to dig for target materials and send them back towards Earth. They will be programmed to explore the surface and identify materials, and be equipped for tasks such as drilling, collecting, and transporting. They may work independently or be controlled remotely from Earth. Unfortunately, these types of robots have yet to be developed since the technology is still young. As technology continues ⓔto develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly emerge. _____ , _____ → _____ , _____ → 실전 학습
answer: ⓑ which → whose, ⓒ to have → to have been
solution: ⓑ which → whose 선행사 'precious metals'의 소유 관계를 나타내는 관계대명사가 필요하다. 뒤에 명사 'value'가 바로 이어지므로 소유격 관계대명사 whose를 써야 한다. which는 주격 또는 목적격 관계대명사이므로 뒤에 명사를 직접 수식할 수 없어 어법상 틀렸다. ⓒ to have → to have been 주어인 'it(water)'은 '간과되는' 대상이므로 수동의 의미가 필요하다. 따라서 능동형 완료부정사 to have overlooked가 아니라 수동형 완료부정사 to have been overlooked로 써야 한다. to have만 쓰면 'water가 무언가를 간과했다'는 능동의 의미가 되어 문맥상 어색하다. ⓐ 'The large ones are called planets'에서 수동의 의미로 과거분사 called가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓓ 'Robots will be sent to dig ~'에서 주어 Robots가 보내지는 대상이므로 수동태 be sent가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓔ 'continues to develop'에서 continue는 to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 동사이므로 to develop이 올바르게 쓰였다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
Asteroid Mining The solar system is composed of many rocks
ⓐfloated in space. The large ones are called planets, and the smaller ones are called asteroids. Research has shown that asteroids contain valuable resources like gold and rare earth elements. For example, one asteroid, 16 Psyche, is reported to consist mainly of gold and other precious metals, ⓑwhose value is equal to billions of dollars per person on Earth. From a space explorers' perspective, however, the most valuable resources from asteroids are neither valuable precious metals nor rare mineral deposits. That valuable resource could actually be water, and it seems ⓒto be overlooked because it doesn't seem as exciting as gold. Water is expensive to transport into space due to its weight and volume. ⓓHave a space station with sufficient water supplies in orbit around Earth would make space explorations much easier. No one knows for sure what asteroid mining will look like, but it seems that robotic mining is most likely. Robots will be sent to dig for target materials and send them back towards Earth. They will be programmed to explore the surface and identify materials, and be ⓔequipping for tasks such as drilling, collecting, and transporting. They may work independently or be controlled remotely from Earth. Unfortunately, these types of robots have yet to be developed since the technology is still young. As technology continues to develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly emerge.
solution: ② 선행사 'one asteroid, 16 Psyche'를 수식하는 소유격 관계대명사 whose가 올바르게 쓰였다. 선행사가 사물이더라도 소유 관계를 나타낼 때는 whose를 쓸 수 있으므로 어법상 옳다. 따라서 ②가 정답이다. ① floated → floating 'many rocks'가 우주에 떠다니는 것을 능동적으로 나타내는 현재분사가 필요하다. rocks가 float하는 주체이므로 수동의 과거분사 floated가 아니라 능동의 현재분사 floating을 써야 한다. ③ to be → to have been 문맥상 물이 간과되어 온 것은 현재보다 이전에 일어난 일임을 나타내므로, 단순 수동 부정사 to be가 아니라 완료 수동 부정사 to have been을 써야 한다. 따라서 'it seems to have been overlooked'가 올바른 표현이다. ④ Have → Having 이 절의 주어 역할을 하는 동명사구가 필요하다. 원형동사 Have는 주어 자리에 올 수 없으므로, 동명사 Having으로 고쳐야 한다. ⑤ equipping → equipped 앞의 'be programmed to explore the surface and identify materials'와 병렬 구조를 이루어야 하므로, 수동태 형태인 'be equipped'가 되어야 한다. equipping은 능동의 현재분사로 문법적으로 잘못된 형태이다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) 공통영어2 4과 문법 정복 실전

The need to explore new frontiers like the Arctic and the American West may have been
ⓐsparked by curiosity, but a major reason was to discover new resources. Without new resources and technology, the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century would not have led to the rise of new industries and ⓑthe growth of cities. In the late 20th century, the Information Technology Revolution connected the world and
ⓒtransformed economies. Now, it seems that space is the latest frontier for entrepreneurs ⓓto exploring. Finding new resources and exploring the unique environment are new opportunities for those who dare ⓔto take up the challenge.
solution: ④ to exploring → to explore 'for entrepreneurs to explore'에서 'for + 목적어 + to부정사' 구문이 쓰인 자리이다. to부정사는 'to + 동사원형'의 형태를 취해야 하므로, to exploring을 to explore로 고쳐야 한다. ① 'may have been sparked'는 수동태 완료 표현으로, 주어인 'The need'가 호기심에 의해 촉발된 것이므로 과거분사 sparked가 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 전치사 'of'의 목적어로 명사구 'the growth'가 올바르게 쓰였다. 'the rise of ~'와 대등하게 연결되어 있으므로 어법상 적절하다. ③ 문장의 주어 'the Information Technology Revolution'에 대한 서술어로, connected와 병렬 관계를 이루는 동사 transformed가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 'dare to take up'에서 dare는 일반동사로 쓰여 to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 구조이며, to take가 올바르게 쓰였다. 비상(홍) 4과 문법 정복 실전

Finding new resources and exploring the unique environment are new
ⓑopportunities for those who dare to take up the challenge. Asteroid Mining The solar system is composed of many rocks floating in space. The large ones are called planets, and the smaller ones are called asteroids. Research has shown that asteroids contain valuable resources like gold and rare earth elements. For example, one asteroid, 16 Psyche, is reported to consist mainly of gold and other precious metals, whose value is equal to billions of dollars per person on Earth. From a space explorers’ perspective, however, the most valuable resources from asteroids are neither valuable precious metals nor rare mineral deposits. That valuable resource could actually be water, and it seems to have been ⓒovervalued because it doesn’t seem as exciting as gold. No one knows for sure what asteroid mining will look like, but it seems that robotic mining is most likely. Robots will be sent to dig for target materials and send them back towards Earth. They will be programmed to explore the surface and identify materials, and be equipped for tasks such as drilling, collecting, and transporting. They may work ⓓindependently or be controlled remotely from Earth. Unfortunately, these types of robots have yet to be developed since the technology is still young. As technology continues to develop, better methods for obtaining materials will undoubtedly ⓔvanish.
